title: Owned a Traeger for over 12 years
text: Hello.  I had a friend who was a butcher at a very big butcher shop in Portland Oregon.  After tasting his food many times he shared with me what it was he was cooking his BBQ meats on - a Traeger!  Well he just raved about this grill and he even had a local show on TV  to show how he used his grill to make the most fabulous dinners.We decided then to purchase one of our own.  I purchased the 34 inch grill......back then I think it was the only grill that Traeger offered - this was in the late 90s..  Anyway we bought and loved it.  We would have large BBQ parties throughout the years.  We were known for our 4th of July parties.  We would have many families over.... I would smoke over 6 turkeys and about 6 pork butts for pulled pork for our 4th of July party.  The Traeger sure helped out our cooking time and the taste was far superior to that of regular wood smoking.As a hint since our parties were so huge we would smoke our meats about two weeks before the party. Before the party.   After the meat was cooked to perfection we would vacuum seal them in one of those units that take out all the air and vacumn seal them - we would slice the meat and put them in to the bags we created with the vacuum sealer.  In the turkey bags we would put turkey broth some orange juice and seasonings and seal it up.  In the pulled pork one we would shread the pork and add some BBQ sauce along with some beef broth and seal those.  We would then put them in our deep freeze and on the day of the party we would take them out and put them in big large pots of boiling water - the bags could be put directly in it without them breaking open.  We would then boil the bags till the meat was hot and then take them to chafing pots and cut them open.  Sure cut a lot of time and it made it easy for us to be with our company instead of cooking in front of them!Our Traeger weathered quite a few huge parties and did us well.  We probably used our grill at least 3 to 4 times a week yearround.  After `12 years my wife decided we needed new - she loved the new 34 pro grill with the bronze finish and so we finally broke down and bought a new one.  I love the additional features it now has with the two probes (which make it a lot easier to judge cooking times) and the variety of settings compared to our old unit old faithful.We are a Traeger family and will always be.  We love the unit and I have always had a good experience with any phone calls that I have made.  I even broke down and bought a litlle tex for our motorhome so we are never without our Traeger.

title: The Life of a 11 Pound Pork Butt
text: The Pork Butt is ready. The Traeger Smoker is ready set at 225 deg. Based on the normal rule of thumb 1-1/2 hours per pound cooking/smoking time I calculated 16.5 hours to cook this Butt. After 8 hours 'BAM' were making Food Coma History. Traeger Grill/Smokers are AMAZING. If you value your time get one of these Grill/Smokers you'll have time to spent with family and friends you never new existed before because you were to busy trying to keep your other grill/smoker consistent.

title: Dream Come True
text: This grill is unreal. I was back and forth between this and a certain popular large green grill you may have heard of. I chose this due to its versatility simplicity portability and overall fantastic buying process.   First the size. I was between this and a bigger one but was assured this would be plenty big. It looks small in pics but you should go see one at a Traeger dealer. Looks bigger in person. I cooked two large rib racks 40 chicken wings and a skillet full of jalapeno poppers on it at one time with a little room to spare.   It's super easy to start up and maintain a temp. It keeps itself anywhere you choose between 225 and 450 with ease. If you open the cover it'll drop of course but gets back to temp very quickly.   I've made ribs pulled pork steaks burgers chicken breast chicken wings and lots of veggies on it so far (had it not even 2 weeks). They've all been great except the chicken breast. That might have been my fault though.   I didn't realize it until I was comparing models but the saw horse legs really made a difference. It seems so much more sturdy than other grills even from Traeger. It's good because I roll it regularly from my patio to my garage and it's super easy with the wheels and the sturdy legs.   The only negative I have about it is that the meat probes aren't instant read. It takes a minute for them to catch up but if you leave the probes in you won't have any problems. Also a 5 gallon bucket doesn't really fit between the hopper clean out and the legs so you could spill some pellets if your'e not careful. By no means a deal breaker but something to keep in mind when using it.   Everything from buying the grill setting up the grill to using the grill has been fantastic. The sales experience was amazing before during and after the sale. There's a million recipes online and all sorts of sites/communities dedicated to these. I highly recommend you look into this. I'm Traeger's newest biggest fan.

text: I've been smoking for many years from the manual add-wood-and-charcoal-all-day-long to electric. All of the parts looked immaculate - no scratches dings burrs bad cuts etc. Traeger really did a good job on the QA for this one. On the initial burn in the smoker got to about 450 degrees and then backed down to around 435-440. Cooking: First cook was 4 racks of spare ribs (with tips) that fit with ease. Best rack of ribs I have ever smoked and the easiest as well no more babysitting the food or smoker. The only downside to the pellet smoker is the extra cost to cook as pellets are not cheap but the taste in the food is definitely superior to electric w/wood chips which makes it worth it to me. title: Excellent Smoking and Grilling
text: I purchased my Pro 34 almost a year ago.  Have had great success with all meats I have  smoked or grilled.  I have a cheap Brinkman electric smoker that was my intro into the smoking world about ten years ago.   The Traeger is so simple.  Set the temp you need and in ten to fifteen minutes you are ready to smoke or grill.  With the temp probes you can check meat temp as your cooking progresses.  I have used both probes multiple times. On Mother's Day weekend I was asked to smoke many different meats.  I accepted the challenge and simultaneously smoked baby backs pork shoulder and tri-tip roast. Tri-tip was done first in two and half hours to a beautiful 130 degrees F.  The ribs were smoked using the 1-2-3 method and were excellent  The shoulder took almost 16 hours to reach my desired temp of 204-205 F.  All smoking was set at 225 F.  I pushed it to 250 F to finish pork shoulder.  All this was for two meals and many food saver bags going home with my kids and other family. My Traeger Pro 34 has performed excellently! Also if you smoke or grill a lot check under grease drain pan and heat baffle.  If there is a buildup of wood dust ash and a little grease I use a shop vac to clean out dust and ash. Wipe up grease with paper towel. Also clean out firepot as recommended.

text: I have had experience with a  offset wood fired smoker before but never really made anything awesome.  Had some decent but not mouthwatering results with brisket ribs and pork but.  That has all changed.  I got the Pro 22 yesterday assembled it cured it and reviewed recipes and You Tube for pointers.  I made beef ribs today and they turned out fantastic!!  It's almost a set it and forget it with the digital system.  I can't wait to get to the butcher and make some more smoke. I'm not looking to win a BBQ competition; I just want to be able to make great smoked meat for my friends and family.  I have the answer in my new grill.

title: One tiny flaw
text: I have the bronze pro 22 ..but the flaw is on almost every traeger that is the plate mounted on the legs on the end of grill with handle for moving it.. should be  cut differently..If you move your grill often like I do the plate hits you I. The shin's as you try to push that grill...it either needs a cut out arch or to be set alitte higher up... I put my traeger away in a she'd after each use...So it's completely protected ..And everyone curses trying to get it there ..or out..Other then that Love it

title: Forever Changed
text: I have been a typical LP grill person until the last 6 months. I purchased this Pro Series 34 and will not be looking back! I have been very impressed with the performance construction ease of use and amazing recipes. Every meal I make on this cooking machine turns out perfect. During the summer we like to cook pizza but hate heating up the house. Enter Traeger. Pizzas come out crispy and cooked evenly. Following their Pork Chop recipe they come out moist and flavorful every time (and I have rarely had that experience on a gas grill). I have used this grill for breakfast lunch and dinner and cannot take any of the compliments for fine cooking it is all done by my Traeger! I am trying to make converts of friends and family. Can't say enough about this awesome grill!

title: Best money I ever spent.
text: Since we got the Pro22 we haven't used the gas grill or oven. Everything from ribs to brisket meatloaf and Mac and cheese come out fantastic. I made pulled pork for a party our Daughter had and everybody loved it. Simple to assemble and easy to use. My only regret is that I didn't get a bigger one. lol

title: More than I expected
text: I have had my Treager for over a month I've cooked brisketribs dogs burgers chicken legs on this grill and no one has anything negative to say about my meats I'm truly impressed with this grill considering a bigger one for next year

title: Best grill ever
text: I have had my Traeger for little over a month now. I have grilled steaks burgers pork bellies pizza and chicken breasts on this thing. They turned out pretty good except it wasn't set it and forget it. I had to check the food regularly to ensure I didn't over cook it because like 1 other review my temperature just wouldn't get to the proper temp but it was definitely getting hot. In an attempt to diagnose why I was having this issue when only 1 other person has had this issue I noticed my internal probe was touching the side of the grill. I bent it slightly inward so it was no longer touching the side. I now get to temperature within the 15 minutes and the last chicken breast came out perfect. I strongly recommend this grill for anyone who not only loves to grill but even just enjoys good food.

title: Buy One
text: I have been cooking barbeque for 25 years. I use everything from gas burners to stick smokers. I put off buying a pellet smoker until now. Best decision I have ever made! Consistent temps and  even heat. It is my go to cooker now.

title: Works as advertised with a couple of minor problems.
text: My Traeger Pro Series 22 has really exceeded my expectations.  I did read from other users that it is a great smoker but not a good grill.  I think it works great as a grill.  After grilling chicken pieces I baked a pan of brownies and they were as good as if they were done in the oven.  Traeger advertises that but frankly I didn't believe it would work that well.    My problem is with the temp probes.  The first time I used the unit they worked fine.  After that they haven't worked at all.  I needed to go out and by a separate digital meat temp probe which works perfectly except for having to open the grill to check the meat.    I also noticed a temperature swing of at least 25 degrees during my last cook.  I was smoking three racks of ribs at 225 deg.    We will see if that continues next time.    For the most part I would have to say I love it and would do it again.  It is a perfect size for me and I have already appreciated being able to empty the hopper

title: CD
text: Worth every penny! This is a great grill that turns an average cook into a great one! It arrived on a pallet and was packaged well. Everything went together easily and the finish of the product is solid. It was together in less than an hour. The grill works amazing! It's quick to get to temp accurate in holding the temp you set it to and puts out an amazing product! It also cycles down quickly so it's fast and easy to cool down and put away. Highly recommend the front shelf and a cover for accessories.

title: Worthy investment
text: I upgraded from the Big Tex to the Pro 34 series and very happy with the grill. The Big Tex was purchased in '07 and still works great. If you enjoy grilling then the Traeger is for you.

title: GAME CHANGER !!!
text: Prepare to get slapped in the face by your TONGUE !!!!  Easy to put together instructions. The food is life changing and you will never need to over pay for another STEAK SEAFOOD CHICKEN  BURGER PIZZA whatever again in your life. You can eat like a king every night for 1/3 the cost of a over priced restaurant meal.  OHHHH  did I mention the TASTE  !!!   OUT OF THIS WORLD !!!  BIG THUMBS UP TRAEGER GRILLS !!!

title: Bad auger
text: Ordered a smoker for my husband for his birthday. He went to set it up and it didn't work. He called traeger and they were very good about it. They sent us a new auger. Disappointed in spending $700  on a smoker only for us to not be able to use it upon opening.

title: Pro series 22 Temp
text: I have had my grill now for 3 weeks and am very happy with it overall.  I do note that the grill has trouble holding at the desired temp.  I have had to watch it carefully as it seem to have trouble reaching and holding the desired temp. Other than that the pit is great cooks very well and was a great buy.

title: Wonderful grill/smoker
text: Used for the first time yesterday. Did pork tenderloin. Great job!!!! Off around 30 minutes on the timing but after tasting the finished product our guess said it was worth the wait. Used Traeger cherry pellets with the pork rub. Did add a bit of my own butter/honey brush on for the last hour before resting for 20 minutes. Very happy I (well actually my wife convinced me to spend the extra money for a Traeger) with my new grill.

title: I'll never go back!
text: I love my Treager grill I don't have to stand guard over whatever I'm cooking or grilling smoking doesn't matter what you cook  I've had 4 or 5 big BBQ's and grilling every other day I started with two bags of Pellets and we still have over half a bag...Propane?! What propane?    'I'l never go backl

title: Easy assembly!
text: I'm not gonna lie I haven't cooked on it yet. But assembly and instructions a notch above the rest. They literally thought of everything....by everything the instructions also include grabbing a six pack! They put notches in places where you would normally struggle to tighten it to make it easier. They also include 1 extra of each screw washer and nut just in case.....Genius!!!! If this thing cooks just as well I'll be a fan for life. Just the assembly made it worth the premium price!!

title: Will never go back again!
text: I will say I will never return to ordinary grills again.  I first bought the smaller 24 inch model but quickly saw the enjoyment the delicious products brought to my family's faces at dinner and lunch.  I have found nothing this thing doesn't cook well if you follow the instructions.  No Grease Flare Ups. just good tender moist great tasting food.  I even pleased my mother in law who will no longer order Ribs out as she says they are not even close to the ribs I do on my traeger.  If you are on the fence of this grill don't hesitate.  I know they are expensive but you get what you pay for.  Again all I can say is if God tarry's and allows I will cook on nothing else but a Traeger ever again.  Wish I could afford the commercial one  LOL but I fear that might cause a divorce.

title: WORK'S WELL BUT TOO EXPENSIVE
text: The grill works very well but is a bit temperamental.  I have cooked 4 briskets and they came out delicious.  My wife particularly likes pizza cook on the grill.  The grill grates are very easy to clean.  The steel construction is great heavy duty and the grill is easy to use (per say).  However I thoroughly believe the grills are too expensive.  The downside is that the 2 grill pans (flame guard and drip pan) rust really bad and fast.  The other draw back are the pellets: They must be stored inside the home where the air is condition.  The wood pellets draw moisture from the air which makes them burn less hot which interferes with heat temperatures.  Lastly it takes a long time to reach higher temperatures especially during the winter time; a blanket Overall I gave it a 4 because I can fill the hopper and cook for 5  hours without refueling.  Once it's fired-up it cooks really good.  I would give it a 5 but it is too temperamental.  It's difficult to reach higher temperatures which throws my timing off and at times when I least expect to malfunction.  When it does malfunction I forced to restart the grill.

title: Love our treager
text: We bought a Renegade Elite two years ago wish we would have bought it sooner. Best smoker/grill I've ever used. Absolutely wonderful.going to buy the extra rack. Friends and family love the flavor wife and  I love cooking on it. Thanks for a GREAT product.

title: $1000 chicken cooker
text: I hope you sell a lot of these.  I don't  want to be the only fool. I consider myself a better than average cook.  I have yet to have any meat except chicken to compare with my other wood fired cookers.  Living on a ranch; beef is our preferred meat. Following your cookbook leads to disappointment.  Your unit is  15 degrees off the thermostat. I see your pretty pictures and there's no way you get that searing. I have several cookers (griddles stoves pits fryers etc.) This by far the worst.

title: Smokin
text: Have wanted one of these smokers for a long time and finally got the 34'. It smokes great have had it for 3 week have used it 6 times and I'm getting better at it each time. Not  bragging lol. It use as a lot of pellets come parred to my friends 22 pro. that's my only complaint.

title: My first Traeger and an excellent choice
text: What isn't to like.  I didn't want any regrets about purchasing a small one and this has many more features than the Elite 34 just do it already.

title: Pro Series 22
text: I have used this a bunch of times and used there recipes for use. It makes the food taste so good. Thinking about upgrading to new one. Don't wait to get one its worth it.

title: In love
text: I absolutely love my new Traeger!!! As a blogger I am always looking for fun new ways to prepare and create delicious recipes! The traegar has exeeded my expectations and I have made my best meals ever on this grill.

title: The Best.... PERIOD.
text: This is the best grill I've owned and Traeger is a great company to deal with.  Everything I cook on my Pro 34 comes out juicy and delicious and assembly was quick and simple.  I'm never going back to propane or charcoal!  I had a problem where a couple of parts ended up breaking when my grill flipped over while moving it and Traeger stood behind their product and shipped me replacement parts right away.  They had me cooking again in a few days like it never happened.  You may find a similar grill out there at a lower price but are you really getting a Traeger quality grill or their outstanding service?  My guess is no.   Keep up the good work Traeger I'll be a repeat customer if and when I ever need to replace this grill.

title: Game changer
text: I've owned charcoal and gas bbqs in the past and thought they were the only options I had. Once I heard about Traeger wood fired  pellet grills I was intrigued and heard nothing but rave reviews about them from their owners.  I bought mine based upon these recommendations and I'm happy I did. I've never had such an easy time cooking food  that's so delicious!  I have become a Traeger evangelist and lifelong customer.

title: VERY IMPRESSED
text: I recently purchased a Pro series 22 Traeger grill. I've been grilling for about 45 years I grew up in Santa Maria CA and have used almost every type of grill there is. The Traeger has quickly become my favorite grill ever. From easy assembly to quick start up and great temp control it has every feature I need for back yard grilling. I grilled a tri-tip last night and brought it to work for an offic lunch and everyone was impressed. I did have one small problem with assembly my lifting partner dropped his end and bent the hopper cover. New one ordered and received in less than 5 days. I've purchased the best and last grill I will ever need!

title: Trea gear series 22
text: This was the best investment ever . We cook with it nightly . Love it love it love it .

title: Works Okay
text: Let me start out by saying I'm tradionally a stick smoker. With that said. I have used my Treager a couple times now and it works well. My Major complaint is it doesn't leave a smokey taste or smoke ring that I'm use too. I even use the Treager at the smoke setting and still don't get a lot of smoke I'm use too. I would expect the smoking chamber to have smoke in it and see smoke coming out of the smoke stack and I don't see either. Very disappointed in the none existent smoke and smokering. This is what I get for impulse buying.

title: Smoker?
text: As a BBQ grill it isn't too bad. Regrettably I wanted A smoker. The only way to get that taste with a Traeger is to use Liquid Smoke.  Can't emphasize this enough. There is smoke but NO FLAVOR!!

title: A MUST OWN
text: I hate reviews. They are byass and some (not all) use them as a personal vendetta. I do not write them. HOWEVER I have to tell u about how I feel about my Traeger experience. I recently built an outdoor kitchen and I installed a 42 inch Lynx. I like it but then a month after I built It purchased  a Traeger 22. Now I wish I could return my 4K Lynx cause I never use it. The only complaint that I have with my Traeger is that I didn't purchase the larger model. It is a MUST OWN. My wife loves it cause every weekend I'm cooking something different. I am yet to be disappointed. I should go to work for them because I am such a fan I tell everyone and anyone who will listen. You MUST HAVE ONE IN YOUR BACKYARD front yard tailgate or any place u can fit one. ABSOLUTELY A MUST HAVE.

title: good grill
text: Great grill    I have purchased 3 traegers.    Handle is on end with vent  you will get grease on you. When you move grill you have to lift handle end you will hit your ankles.  I had to buy new leg kit with wheels  $170.00 for the handle end.It NEEDS 4 wheels on it from factory.  I suggest trying to move it before buying it you'll find out.

title: Best Smoker/Grill EVER
text: I have had this the Traeger Elite 34 for just over a year now and wanted a full year to test out this unit before posting a comment.  I have purchased a lot of items over the years and from time to time experienced buyers remorse.   I can unequivocally say that there has never been a day since my son's gave me this unit for Father's Day that I have had any regrets.  I smoke briskets turkeys chickens even hamburgers without any issues.  Not only can you smoke but it makes the most flavorful Chateaubriand or Filet Mignon.  There isn't much you can't do on a Traeger.  Great gift for anyone who loves the convenience of a patio grill but desires the full flavor of a pit smoker.

title: We Love this Grill
text: We've been looking at Treager for several years. Finally made the purchase. We couldn't be happier. The immense number of recipes we get each week are amazing.  The grill makes cooking out everyday a breeze. We don't know why we waited so long.  We look forward to many years of easy meal prep and lots of great memories. Thank you Treager!!!

title: Best grill I have owned
text: I have had this grill for several months.  It does take a little trial and error  but once you use it for a while you will never go back to propane natural gas or charcoal.  I have just recently smoked  an eleven pound prime rib for thanksgiving diner  no fuss just season put it on and insert the probe and your good to go.  No guess work as to whether its done the probe lets you know and its perfect. It was the most tender prime rib I have ever had.  You will nor regret making this purchase!

title: traeger grill pro grill 34
text: since we got this grill it's performed perfectly . we've smoked roasted baked and grilled and it was great. easy to clean up and we use disposable aluminum heat guards make clean up easy   I recommend that you get the folding shelf .life-saver !

title: Two Thumbs Up!
text: Well this grill/smoker is great!  I have used it only once but I will be doing something at least once a week now (I hope)!  I did a smoked turkey for Thanksgiving and I did not have a back-up plan if things fell through.  The grill is easy to use and I enjoyed a few beers sitting outside with my family while getting a waft or two of pecan smoke.  REALLY glad I got the larger one.  If you are on the fence go for the larger one - you won't regret it.  You should also order the folding front shelf - 100% a requirement.  Initial set-up was a breeze and the instructions were clear.  Improvements: I do wish the temp probes had bluetooth and alarm capability.  I think I'll be getting a Weber iGrill.  Also a little bit of a nickel and dime approach that the front shelf is an add-on at this price point.

title: Excellent Grill
text: WOW I researched the Traeger Grill for 6 months not sure I would like the grill...I LOVE IT!!  Easy to use and the food it great!  I did have to contact customer support for an issue and they handled my issue within 5 minutes to my satisfaction!  I would recommend this grill to anyone!

title: I love it can't stop cooking!
text: I've been smoking meat and grilling for decades.  Currently have an egg Weber kettle Weber gas (for lazy days)  and just replaced a horizontal barrel smoker with a Pro 34 a week and a half ago.  Gotta admit I am blown away!  It's been used every day since I built it.  Assembly was straight forward and simple.  Construction is top notch.  I've done wings ribs thighs whole chickens chicken quarters and a few snacks.  All came out awesome.  The recipies at Traeger.com are great for ideas and easy to follow if you choose lots of variety.  I would suggest Traeger to everyone!  Now I just need to find a home for the egg and the gas grill as I probably won't use them anymore.

title: Great grill
text: I am really happy with the pro22. Had a jr and wanted to get one a little bigger went to a different brand bad mistake returned the other unit went back to Traeger. So satisfied with this unit.

title: Change for the Better
text: Being new to wood pellet grilling we're learning every time. Ruining a piece of meat is easy enough on any grill. Getting it right on my Pro22 is hard to beat.  Realized that I previously only cooked quick pieces of meat and now appreciate the results of roasting a meal over 4-8 hours. Good results come quickly and are delicious.  Had a problem with the internal temperature probe. Explained the issue to Customer Service. They were promptly responsive. Replacement part arrived quickly with instructions and replacement was easy.  Am beginning to understand the concept of 'Traeger Family'.  Quality product and good customer service.

title: second rack
text: just wondering way this elite 34 large pellet grill only came with one large rack for the price it should have come with the top small rack.

title: Traeger Newbe
text: I was a little skeptic that's just me. I am a true stick burner cratering trailer fanatic. Which boils down to being close minded and thinking that there is not anything out there that can produce better product than my pull behind trailer. Now I do have this beat by quantity but I sure don't have it beat by taste. I was impressed dumbfounded speechless and just now a true believer in the Traeger pellet grill. Today is Friday 12/14/18 I have had this grill for three weeks now to the date. I have cooked on it 12 times I am hooked 10 different bags of 10 different flavors. like I said I was going to give this thing the test. Using the cookbook that came this grill I tried a lot of different things the pulled pork was just words can't explain it it was that good.  the deep-dish pizza twice in 7 days That good. Even tried some of my recipes smoked meatballs hhhuummm why didn't I get this grill sooner? I love it all I have to say. it is a little on the pricey side but cleaning is at a minimal if you can't have this grill clean and ready for the next cook in 5 minutes or less you have a problem. I friend on mine has had his Traeger for 11 years now and still using it. I don't know about you but I go through grills wear them out they might last 2-3 years and gone to the curb but 11 years and still using it I think that just took care of the price thing it did for me.  it you are riding the fence and trying to decide maybe yes maybe no ... get it you will not regret it it is just too easy to use. Even if your just an ok cook this will bump up your status you are only as good as your equipment you use...

title: Great Grill
text: I received one as a Christmas gift Cooked on it a few times now and I absolutely love it. I would most definitely recommend this grill for anyone looking to purchase a grill.

title: Nothing Beats the Traeger
text: We started with a Traeger Junior and it was awesome but we soon out grew it and wanted bigger.  We didn't want to spend the dollars so after reading reviews of the Pitt Boss we bought a Pitt Boss. Well it was a big mistake.  We've had nothing but trouble with it and honestly I don't think it cooks as week as the Traeger. We found ourselves using the Jr more and more. So we bit the bullet and for Christmas bought the Traeger Pro!  We've already cooked several meals on it and YES it's the best!  Don't skimp always opt for the Traeger!!

title: Treager
text: If you're thinking about it because of the price it's worth every penny! This grill does it all!  5 star!

title: Oh HOLY Mother of Grills
text: I got this grill for Christmas assembled it the day after (which by the way the 'how many beers it takes' depiction is great) downloaded the App cooked 2 whole chickens along with a Venison Meatloaf the next day and then a 20lb Turkey and a 11lb Ham the day after. Besides all the room this grill has it is awesome to just to set a temp and walk away. Living in Michigan in Dec/Jan I heard some grills have an issue keeping temp but this grill did a great job. I did find out that if your cooking instructions call out for one certain temp up it desired by 25 or 50 degrees (in cold weather) towards the end to get the desired inner meat temp up otherwise your cook time may be doubled.

title: awesome
text: The best grill I've ever owned hands down! Simple easy and fun! cant wait to cook more on my pro 22!

title: Pro 22 series bronze

title: B'QUE GUY IN SOUTH DAKOTA
text: I always grill everyday, unless on death bed and I LOVE this grill!  No problems and have it down to a "T".  Very pleased to go from propane to pellets.

title: best grilling device since fire
text:
i finally pulled the trigger after researching and talking to a lot of users of varies brands.... got the pro22..  got her home and seasoned then we cooked a couple rib eyes using the beef rub.   WOW.  only at Ruths Chris have i had a steak that tender and juicy....  no burning, no flair ups, no nasty propane flavor.

will update review later after i try more of the recipes in the book..... so far.LOVE THIS GRILL.

text:

Shortly from barrel to brains it will be new trying to figure out why it keeps shutting off. So I have to watch it. On the plus side support has been terrific I just wish I’d needed them less. It’s been outf commission a month or so waiting for parts and i miss it. 

I was disappointed to learn they are now made in China instead of the USA. 

Still recommend it though.

title: 17 Degrees outside, perfect brisket.
text: Bought this about a week ago, my garage smells like a BBQ joint and it's awesome. It was easy to put together. It works on mark. We love it so far, if anything changes, we'll let you know.

title: Easy to use
text: Brought my first grill  after assembly fire it up and cooked ribs turned out beautiful

title: Simply perfection
text: I dont leave reviews normally. I purchased this grill yesterday to do up a pork shoulder for pulled pork. Man was it so simple and easy set and forget. Also the online community was awesome the app gives ya ideas to try new things as well as tips and tricks!

title: Well built lots of cooking area needs a few thing
text: I was able to purchase the 780 pro the day before it came out from my local Home Depot, It is my first pellet smoker. It seems well-built and has lots of cook area. I wish it had a heavy smoke setting for traditional bbq  Also it may work better with Bluetooth rather than Wi-Fi. The honeycomb grate inside the hopper does not come out making it difficult to switch out the pellets.

title: Grill perfection!
text:
I recently upgraded from a Traeger Lonestar Elite to the new Ironwood 650 and I love it! The new barrel shape gives you so much more grilling space, the downdraft system gives you a super smoky flavor and the WiFire technology lets you download your recipe to the grill and it does all the work while you enjoy life! All the changes and upgrades are outstanding!

The packaging even gets an A+...Traeger printed a kid’s dream log cabin on the inside of the box so after your done you cut a corner open, reverse the box, tape it back together and cut out the windows and door and the kids can go to town!

All the promotional materials on the front of the grill are magnets so you don’t have to try and get stickers off your grill.

title: Love it
text: We started with a pro blue 20 then got a pro 34 now the ironwood wow what a difference it’s my new favorite toy we supersmoked two tri-tip 5 leg quarters and 15 lollipop chicken legs it was amazing

title: Perfect results and simple to use
text: I've been waiting for a new Traeger since Christmas 2018 when they sold out of the Timberline. It was worth the wait! Traeger outdid themselves on every single detail. From the simple unpackaging to assembly that a third grader could complete. The Ironwood is for everyone from beginners to experts. Operating is easier than ever with the new controller and app. I've been accustomed to the tailgater and this is a delight compared to that. I've baked stuffed chicken, slow cooked pot roast, and high heat grilled jerk chicken. All have turned out wonderful. The only thing I'm not sure of is when on super smoke, you don't see smoke rolling out like you'd expect. They say it's because blue smoke is barely visible and the white smoke is cold and stale anyways. All in all I give the Ironwood an A+. I switched my order from the Timberline to this and have no regrets. Rec Tec lovers will be crying when they see this on your deck!

title: Great griller now!
text: I was never a very good griller before, but now, WOW! Everything I’ve tried has turned out wonderful! Chicken thighs are amazing, hamburgers outstanding and I so enjoy not having to fight flame ups and nasty clean ups. I’m going to buy another one for our cabin in the mountains of New Mexico!

title: Best Traeger Yet!
text: Picked up the IronWood 650 at a local dealer a week before it dropped. Several uses later and this thing does not disappoint!  Gets very hot and holds the temp within +/- 7 degrees the entire cook. The thing weighs over 350lbs but glides on the wheels. Can’t wait to do a brisket next week!  Highly recommend this grill!!

title: Consistent quality and ease of use.
text: So happy that I purchased a new Ironwood 650.  The D2 system is not a gimmick.  There is a very noticeable difference between this grill and my old Gen 1 grill.  The ease of use is astonishing.  I use my app to control the Ironwood for most of my cooks.  This has allowed me more time to sit with family and friends while dinner cooks.  The consistency of the cook time, quality and flavor is what I'm most happy with.  I can get the same results cook after cook on this grill.  I've done high heat and low and slow with excellent results.  If you're on the fence about buying this model, or wondering if you should upgrade from a Gen 1, Do it!  You will not regret buying this model.  I'm so happy I made the decision to buy it myself.

title: Love Our Ironwood 885!!
text: The new D2 Augers are awesome. Grill heats up significantly faster than the older models, and the fact that you can control the grill by your phone is amazing! Thanks for creating such a great grill y'all!

title: Best grill yet!
text: This is my third Traeger grill and I am impressed with the upgraded WiFire technology making it even easier to control my cook. I love the convenience of keeping track of my temps and the progress of my cook through the app. These new grills make what used to be a challenging day of cooking into something convenient and delicious. My temperatures are consistent and the quality of the grills is great. The only reason I upgrade to a new grill is for the new technology (I like new tech stuff) since the craftsmanship of the grill will last a lifetime.

title: Best in the business!
text: Stop wasting your time with propane! You can literally cook anything with a Traeger, it does it all!

title: Love the new technology and Wifire
text: Got my NEW generation traeger and I can’t stop ranting and raving about it! I love that I don’t have to log out of my home wifi to log onto the traeger Grill WiFire set up. It’s such an awesome touch to be able to name your grill also! This grill gets SUPER HOT SUPER FAST too. I can’t stop loving it!!!!

title: Traeger Does it Again!
text: I’ve done dozens of cooks on my Pro575 and I have been nothing but pleased. Turbo Temp gets me cooking sooner and recovers quicker, the D2 Direct Drive is extremely efiicient (pellet saver), WiFire is now a necessity and this sucker maintains temp almost as well as my Timberline. Rack storage on back is awesome and the magnetic pellet cleanout is simply amazing. My trust in Traeger to cook my food perfectly, continues.

title: Grilling made simple
text: I grabbed this new version ASAP - been looking forward to using it.  I made a few different things since I got it earlier this month, and I am SO impressed.  I am a busy mama, and sometimes I'm just doing too much at the same time, and this makes dinner an easy project. Once you turn it on, stick dinner on, put the probe in and then wait until the app let's me know it's time to take it off, it's reached perfection!

title: Winning!!
text: This grill is the all-star of the new line up. It has some great features that are not overlooked. Like the plug can get removed for travel, the magnet to hold the easy cleanout door open and of course the wifire with D2 Drive! This grill got me a 2nd place call and a Top 10 finish with its first time out in competition

title: Well thought, well built crafted for life!
text: The new ironwood is the new toy you want on your patio this summer! With the capabilities of wifire you’re good to go wherever you are. The extended upper rack and D2 controller both add to the game! Supersmoke some cheese or grill some steaks at 500 degrees, the ironwood has you covered!

title: Never burn a meal again
text:
As a cattle rancher and professional hunter, making sure the meat I serve to my family is of the highest possible standard is critical to honoring the animal that meat came from. Since using the timberline I haven’t ruined a single meal. By being able to monitor and change the temperature of the grill and the meat from inside my house, at work, or even from another state (I’ve done it) I know exactly what is going on with the food I’m making. And it’s delicious. 
•easy to use
•low maintenance
•never burns food
•makes food taste great
I strongly endorse this product.

title: Great Grill with Top Notch Features
text:
I previously owned a Texas Elite grill from Traeger, which I have enjoyed. However, this Pro 575 has been even better. 

I love the convenience of the WiFire feature. It was very easy to set up and I am happy that I don't have to go outside to check the temperature anymore (especially on cold mornings). 

The controller is very intuitive and easy to use as well, and was definitely a nice upgrade for me from my previous grill. 

This grill gets up to temperature very quickly. Even on a couple of sub-freezing days, I was able to set it to maximum temperature without any issues. 

So far I have made ribs, nachos, and brisket on this new grill and so far I am so glad that I went with this model. Definitely recommended!

title: Fantastic All Around
text: This grill does it all! I have done everything from smoke, to braise, to baking desserts and sourdough bread on it. The incredibly accurate temperatures make this a must have product. The WIFIRE® tech means I can run errands, or take my daughter to swim class and monitor and change temperatures. The temperature recovery is so quick, and it gets hotter, faster! I love my Pro 780 and use it almost every day! It's so versatile and performs well with every type of cooking.

title: Wifire- Don’t let Life Get In the Way of Your BBQ
text:
My New Pro575 has Wifire Capabilities and I absolutely love the freedom it brings to me and my family.

Without Wifire I wouldn’t have felt comfortable BBQ-ing until I returned home that evening... this would have forced me to rush the process At higher temperatures and I wouldn’t have 
been happy with the outcome.

title: Ironwood 650
text:
We bought our Traeger about a month ago. I did a lot of research, and have owned quite a few grilles. We have tried everything, propane, charcoal, natural gas, ceramic infrared, etc and never really found a product that performed as advertised. Flare ups, inconsistent heat and mechanical failures were typical. Grilling had become a burden and the fun was definitely not there. Then we purchased our Traeger. Fortunately, we had a really knowledgeable sales person, a real Traeger user, who listened to our sad grilling history and suggested the Ironwood 650. Honestly, I thought the last thing I needed was a WiFi capable grille. I now stand corrected. 

The Ironwood 650 is awesome. It has never failed to deliver fantastic meals. From pork ribs to prime rib, salmon and piazza, this is a cooking machine. Plan your meal, download the Traeger recipe, follow the instructions, hang out with your friends, monitor the Traeger from your phone, gather everyone and enjoy the results. This is delicious fun. Rapidly becoming a devotee. And it’s not just a weekend thing. I can come home, fire up the Traeger, do the prep and have a fantastic meal well under way before my wife gets home. 

Totally happy with the investment in the Ironwood 650, and looking forward to many happy experiences. The wood pellet fuel is easy to handle and seems very cost competitive when compared to charcoal or propane. Even premium lump charcoals don’t delivery the subtitle wood smoke notes that the pellets do. The WiFire handles the thermal management as well if not better than the best indoor ovens. Best of all, it’s easy. Only regret is I didn’t join the Traeger revolution sooner.

title: This thing rocks!

title: Amazing Grill
text:
I can't say enough about how great this grill is. Unfortunately this review will get lost among all the other 100+ 5-Star reviews, but I have to add my opinion because this grill is so great.
I am an above novice griller.  I'll give an example of what this grill does for me:
Our family is a well-done steak family. Any red in the meat is considered raw to my parents. Before I had my Traaeger, we ate expensive, thick, high quality T-bones and tenderloin steaks, cooked to well-one and beyond, resulting in dry, ruined steaks from my point of view. We usually ate $15 hockey pucks and others thought that was how a well-done steak is.
Now, with my Traeger, our well-done steaks are completely different. I believe it's just about impossible to over-cook anything on a Traeger. I can smoke a steak for 3 hours and then quick sear it and I end up with a masterpiece (for a novice griller). I cook them to well-done (and sometimes beyond) and the steaks are always amazing. They have huge smoke rings, incredibly great flavor, and most importantly they're always still juicy! The same goes for chicken and pork. I can over-cook things by 5, 10, 15 minutes, and no matter what, the food is still juicy.
I can't believe how great this grill is. I recommend it for everyone, no matter your grilling experience, but especially for novice or beginners. You just can't screw it up.

(I added a generic photo I Googled to show some great smoke rings. I can get beautiful, large, colorful rings like that on all my meat without even trying!)

title: Best Traeger yet!
text: This is my third Traeger.  I started with a Big Texas, then went to the Select Elite, and now this Ironwood 885.  Every one of them has been an upgrade and I'm very impressed with this grill.  The packaging and ease of assembly was very impressive.  I didn't think I would find much use for the wifi controller and phone app, but I was very mistaken on that.  I LOVE IT!  It's so nice to be able to run errands while your brisket or ribs or whatever is cooking and monitor the actual temperature and make adjustments if needed.  No more wondering if the temperature is where it should be or not.  Not only does this controller adjust in 5 degree increments, but the grill stays at the commanded temp much better than previous models.  Traegers have never imparted as much smoky flavor as other real smokers, but with their "super smoke" mode, it modulates the fan off and on, and although I haven't really decided how much more smoky it makes it, I applaud the effort.  Startup and shutdown seems to take longer than previous models, but that's not a big deal and what I love is how quickly it will get hot once it's going.  I timed it - only 4 1/2 minutes to get from 180 degrees to 350 degrees!  Overall, I love this Traeger and consider it it be a very worthwhile upgrade.

text:
Bought the Ironwood 650 about 3 months ago and have used it at least once a week. Overall it is a good pellet grill. I upgraded from my 13 year old Lil Tex that has been an awesome and reliable grill. The 650 is quick on the startup, easy to control, and the wifi is almost perfect. Two things I do not like compared to my old Traeger. One is the grill does not produce as much smoke even in Super smoke mode. Most of the smoke goes out the grease drain, not the vent on the back. The door does not seal as well either as the seal on mine is to thick an holds the door open a little. This in turn allows heat out specifically by the control unit that seems to get quite hot. Also I end up with a lot of ash on my food which I never had with the old Traeger.  I believe the fan on this new Trager is to powerfull and blows ash all over inside the grill and it also cycles too fast in super smoke mode and will not allow the pellets to produce enough smoke.
    The Traeger wifi app has 2 issues. First issue is the probe alarm only alarms on the grill, not on you phone through the app. Kind of useless to have unless you sit right by the grill so you can hear the alarm. Second issue is the app disconnects every time your phones screen timer turns of the screen. So, everytime you pick up your phone to check things, you have to wait for it to reconnect before you get any information and sometimes it just plain locks up and will not connect. 
    Overall I like the grill. I just wish Traeger would tune the fan a little more and I think it would be an excellent grill.

title: Pellet problem, not BBQ problem
text: I bought a Traeger Pro at Costco which came with pellets and it worked great for 6 months. Bought another bag of pellets at Costco and the pellets are 2 inches long, glossy, and hard as rocks. Now my BBQ will 'auto shut-off' for low temp and 'auto shut-off' for high temp, and just having all sorts of temperature fluctuations. Since the BBQ worked great on the other pellets, I finally figured out it was the pellets. The problem I found was the new pellets are too long, and the auger can't break them up and jambing, causing low temp. When it finally surges and spits a ton of pellets into the 'firepot', it gets too hot. I contacted Traeger, and was told the pellets they sell on their website "don't do this". I bought Trager branded pellets from Costco so how was I to know? The grill gets 5 stars, C.S. gets 1 star making 3 stars. Here is the fix: I finally put some pellets in a bucket and smashed them with a sledge hammer. The grill works great now. Just cooked a tri-tip for 6 hours on smoke, no problem. NOW I just need to smash 33 pounds for pellets from Costco. Not thrilled.

title: Ironwood 650 first pellet smoker
text:
We decided upon the new Ironwood 650 for our first pellet smoker.  I’ve always had a huge desire to learn how to smoke delicious meat but lack the time to operate and babysit a traditional smoker.  Traeger’s new for 2019 features and the new Ironwood model was a perfect fit.  Assembly was easy and seasoning the grill was a cinch.  Our first smoke was a beef brisket.  Used a recipe from the Traeger app.  Was blown away with how simple it was and the fantastic results!  We started searching for recipes all over the internet.  Found a great recipe for pork shoulder “Boston Butt” for pulled pork on Heygrillhey and produced the best pulled pork I’ve ever eaten!  Have produced over a dozen more since.  Usually smoke two at a time which doesn’t add much time to the smoke.  We save the pulled pork with our food saver in 1-2 lbs packages and currently have over 60 lbs in the freezer for easy meals going forward.  We usually start the smoke around 7 pm and it finishes around 10 am the following day.  The meat needs to rest wrapped in tinfoil for about 60-90 minutes in a cooler and is ready for a noon meal.  

Other reviewers state that you need a strong WiFi signal which we found to be true.  We had to purchase a network extender to boost our signal to the deck where the Traeger is located.  Once we solved that issue, the WiFi app is amazing!  It’s fun to monitor the progress on the grill.  We use the probe all the time and have had no issues.  We calibrated the probe per the instructions and it works flawlessly.  We constantly check it with a high end grilling probe and they are within 5* of each other when inserted into the same hole.  My only complaint is that the Ironwood 650 only has a single probe.  We usually montitor multiple roasts with our handheld probe while the Traeger probe gives a current status at all times.

Maintenance is easy!  Our app sends us great recipes and also a care/use guidelines which we follow regularly.  We store our grill using a genuine Traeger cover which is of very high quality.  Also purchased a drumstick/wing rack and haven’t used it yet but hope to soon!  We use Traeger pellets and have noticed nice changes in flavor profiles when switching pellets.  Our favorites have been the pecan or apple wood for pork and hickory for beef.  

Grilling steaks and burgers with the reverse sear has had mediocre results.  I guess I’m accustomed to the beautiful high temp searing from my Big Green Egg.  Ribeye steaks seared on the Traeger have more of a prime rib roast flavor and texture that melt in your mouth but lack the charred outside sear I crave.  I’ll probably stick to my Egg for grilling steaks and burgers per my personal preference.  

Overall, we LOVE our Traeger Ironwood!  The downdraft smoke with the thin blue smoke produces exactly as advertised.  We hope it lasts many many years and continues to wow our family and friends with spectacular results.  Highly recommend this smoker and all Traeger products!

title: Phenomenal Grill, Extremely Well Constructed!
text: I absolutely love this grill!  I ordered it directly from TraegerGrills.com.  I was worried about damage in shipment, but it was packed so well that there was it arrived in pristine condition.  I then unpacked it and found several surprises -- more on that later.  I began putting it together and the instructions, parts, and hardware made it seamless.  They even include the screwdriver, crescent wrench and allen wrench you will need.  I had it assembled in no time.  I do highly recommend you have another person nearby for some parts of assembly, such as flipping it over to attach the legs, as you'll have a higher risk of  damaging your grill if you do it by yourself.  Its very sturdy and heavy.  Once assembled, the instructions on how to start it up were simple and very easy to follow.  I did run into one small issue with connecting the WiFi portion, and I was worried that I'd be dead in the water since this was 4p on a Saturday, but I saw their support line was open 365 days per year from morning until evening.  I called and I was the 6th person in the queue.  It provided me the option to stay on the line or to keep my place in line and have support call me back. I elected for the latter.  In 2 minutes they called my phone, were very polite, well-spoken and wonderfully helpful.  They helped me solve the issue in less than a minute by asking me a couple of quick questions to assess where in the process I was running into the issue.  Now I was ready to grill!  I first seasoned it following the instructions.   Note: this takes about an hour, so plan on that, but it needs to be done.  Once that was complete, I let the grill cool down all the way because I wanted to see how long it would take to go from ambient temp up to 450 -- it was 23F degrees outside at the time.  To my surprise, it was lightening fast, and even better, I could see the temp increasing real-time from inside my house right on my app.    I then backed it off to the temp I wanted to cook at -- I had two big, juicy steaks to cook.  It cooked them perfectly!  I had two college buddies in town visiting this weekend and they both said the steak was phenomenal with perfect wood-fired flavor.  I used the Signature Blend of Traeger pellets.  My buddies raved about the taste even the next day.  I love this grill and am stoked with my purchase.  Now on to the nice surprises.  I have 3 young children (5, 8 and 11 yrs old).  When I opened the box after it was delivered, I could see printing on the inside of the box.  Well, if you turn the cardboard box inside out after unpacking it, it turns into a playhouse with the printing being a design that looks like a rustic cabin, complete with a window, a door, shakes roof, and an image of the grill in the front of the cabin.   I set it up in the kids' playroom and they had a blast all weekend acting like they were camping "at the cabin."  What kid doesn't love a huge cardboard box to play in? And the printing on it made so much better for imaginary play.  The second nice surprise is the assembly instructions come with suggested amount of your "favorite bottled beverage" to consume with each major step.   Every great assembly project needs the operator to be appropriately well-oiled with assembly juice, right?  I highly recommend this grill.

I bought this grill two months ago, extremely excited about my first Traeger, and I've used it about a dozen times. My thoughts:

-Very difficult to overcook anything 

The bad:
-Display screen is already failing (see photo, bottom left corner of screen)
-Meat temperature probe broke after 1 use (bad probe error sign whenever I plug it in)
-Despite what Traeger advertises, it does not sear meat. If I crank it up to the max setting, 450, I can get weak grill marks on meat at best
-Still haven't found a true smoke setting, even under 200 degrees it doesn't get smoky enough

Overall, this thing basically functions as an outdoor oven. The only benefit over an oven is that it imparts a woody flavor to the food. If you want to drop Traeger $$$ on an outdoor oven, go for it. If I could do it again I'd stick with a much more affordable and less frustrating charcoal grill.

This makes it easier to put cover on, and does a better job of smoking!  There are a few other great features as well so I'm very pleased.  The only reason for not giving 4 stars is the drip pan underneath is a little weird.  Time will tell how functional, in some ways I really like it, other ways i'm not sure yet.  if you buy their foil covers they don't fit right, so I had to add my own foil as well. Which is fine, but just weird.  Also, I'm still struggling getting the Wi-Fi to work.  I'm fairly tech savvy (at least I think I am) but it had the grill as its own Wi-Fi - so getting it connected to the home network hasn't happened yet.  Instructions are very clear and I love that it has a scan code on the inside!  However, so far I don't have it working yet.  So depending on drip pan and Wi-Fi this review could go to full 5 or down to a 3!  But it is a great grill and I do recommend it.

I read every review I could find, weighed the pros and cons, went back and forth, sat on the fence, and refused to buy one because “I’m a charcoal guy.” Well after my Weber was broken during a move, I decided to replace it with the Traeger...
I wish I hadn’t waited so long. Everything I cook is delicious and cooked to near perfection. Instead of going out to eat on the weekends, we just try new recipes.
Hopefully others had the same questions I had that I can answer here:
-In 3 months I’ve gone through a total of 3 bags of pellets. I use the grill every single Sunday for food prep for the week. On extended weekends I’ll use it up to 3 times. I smoked a turkey and a brisket on Thanksgiving and only went through about half a bag of pellets in about 12-13 hours of smoke.
-Unless you already have some sort of rolling BBQ cart/stand, just buy the front shelf. I wish I had bought it with the original purchase. I ultimately ended up ordering one.
-So far, I’ve used hickory as the universal go to pellet. My local Home Depot only carries mesquite and hickory so I was limited in my options. I’m starting to order some of the other pellet flavors but I want to make sure I’m going to use them for multiple recipes.
-Use the probe, the “times may vary due to weather conditions” statement is very true.
-Be prepared to plan your meals a few days in advance. The wait times for marination is totally worth it.
-Make a brisket.

Hope this helps someone as indecisive as I was.

2. Turn pellet top and wood board sideways so functional

4. When Super Smoke is turned on leave words on screen - "Super Smoke On"
5. Fix heat seals under hood and around grill better - Snaps come loose too much

title: Love the temperature control.
text:
OK, So I bought the Traeger Pro. I was skeptical to say the least given the hefty price. 
I want to say from the get go that I have never done a brisket in my life. I've done many a slab of ribs and pulled porks but never a brisket since I'm not a big fan of brisket in the first place.
My brisket only weighed about 4 pounds. I only bought it because I have this new grill and due to COVID-19 the local grocery store had nothing else worthy of such a grill. I did my research and cooked the thing with the timer at about 5 hours with the temp probe in the meat. When it reached 195 degrees at right at 5 hours. I pulled it off the grill and let it rest for 45 minutes. I finally cut into it for a taste at the pointed end. It was terrible. Both my wife and I agreed it tasted like liver. I hate liver. I have always hated liver. I was about to throw the whole thing away when I decided to cut into it at it's widest point. It was much juicier and tender there and really not bad. The Traeger coffee rub flavor really came out well. The liver flavor seemed to be a problem with the meat itself and nothing to do with the cook. I once had prime rib at a restaurant that tasted the same way. Never knew why and still don't today. The main thing was I was amazed at the precise temperature control maintained through out the cook. My past experience is with Weber 26 inch kettle grills with either my Smokenator or my Slow & Sear. This was by far superior. I can't wait to do some ribs which is my specialty or a pork butt. I think I'm done with brisket. Never wanted it in the first place. If any one knows why some cuts of meat has a liver flavor, I'd sure like to hear about it.
I also wanted to say, with the drip pan and bucket clean up was a breeze. Pretty much just cleaned the grate. I also liked using the mobile app which was by far better than my Maverick temperature probes. 
I love the grill I can't wait until the market has some better selection of meat to complete my purchase.

title: Great grill, but grease pan needs redesign.
text: Holds a very consistent temperature, but the gap between the grease pan and the edge of the grill grate makes it easily prone to grease fires which ruin meals and are very dangerous. A wider grease pan, probably just elevate a bit more from its current position, would eliminate that end still allow for the airflow needed to create the polling smoke which allows for temperature consistency and even smoke distribution throughout the grill. Also, a larger grease pan should have a steeper pitch on it to ensure all grease flows to the trap. Liners would be more effective if they had a bit of a foldable wing to ensure the actual pan itself is completely covered, eliminating the need for extra foil around the edges. Great flavor, but a real design flaw in my opinion that could be easily fixed.

title: Solid with Some Chinks in the Armor.
text: There are good things and bad things about this grill.  To begin, it is incredibly easy to get started, it's very intuitive (love the wifi) and it is very pleasing to the eye.  An honorable mention is what looks like bullet proof customer service and product support plan.  The bad is the dust created by the the incenerated pellets.  Because there is a fan that circulates the heat, it also circulates a bit of the dust.  It is also recommended to purchase a shop vac to vacuum the dust.  Also, the chimney end of the grill seems to have a hot spot, as well as the edges of the grease ramp.  I noticed my left rack of ribs (chimney side) was cooking quicker than the others.  It could have been the rack of ribs but my gut tells me it's hotter on that end.  The smoke is a bit mild but I can live with that with the ease of use.  Overall, I like the grill, however I find myself charing steaks on my green egg and finishing them on the Traeger.

title: Nice grill - has a learning curve
text:
Purchased a "Mesa 22" model from Costco - near as I can tell, it's the same as the Pro 22 minus the upper rack.

I'm about 6 cooks in to it, and so far, mostly so good. Ribs came out good (only reason they weren't great is my technique was off), spatchcock chicken was incredible, hot smoked salmon was awesome... and then there was the Pork Butt.

I tucked the butt in at 6pm, anticipating an overnight cook. Used a blend of two different Traeger pellets (Hickory & Cherry) from two freshly opened bags. Smoker ran for a few hours, then gave me the LER error which I discovered around 11pm. I got it fired back up, watched it until about 1:30am - it seemed stable. Went to bed, up at 6am - LER error again, and a hunk of 70º meat. Vacuumed everything out of the firebox, started it up again, and it ran until about 2pm - and it happened a third time. Ended up finishing the butt in our oven.

I read that an incorrect starting procedure can cause this, so I will be meticulously following that this coming weekend when I try another one. Also seems possible that the pellets aren't in great shape (but they look fine - shiny & not crumbly at all - the bags were brand new). If that's the case, it'll be irritating to have spent $40 on bad fuel.

The cooks that have finished properly have been fantastic, and I'm not ready to rule out user error with the Butt fiasco, however I have to admit being a bit skeptical about trusting the grill to handle its business unattended. It'll have to work nicely for quite a while for me to trust it for another overnight session.

title: Old Methods Collide with Technology
text:
We just purchased our second Timberline 1300.  This one is for vacation home in southern Utah.  FedEx dropped it off just before noon.  My son and I spent less than an hour assembling it.  Really, the instructions are so well written and the parts are all numbered.  Even the bolts and nuts are separated into phases of assembly.  That evening we smoked chicken.  The next evening we had pork ribs and smoked cauliflower.  Sunday was beef brisket and burnt ends.  I think we got it pretty well seasoned.  We didn't do any reverse searing this last week but steak will never be the same once you try it on a Traeger.  

The double wall insulation of not only the side walls but also the door make this pretty stingy with the fuel.  The Wifire technology makes it so I could even take in 9 holes of golf while I was cooking dinner.  If the cooking is moving too slowly, just turn up the heat from the golf course with the Traeger App on your phone.  If you can't get back soon enough just turn the temperature to "keep warm".  

The Timberline is the perfect blend of the old art of smoking with modern double walled construction and digital technology.  I LOVE wifire technology!   The Timberline 1300 boasts enough room to cook multiple courses for a large family with very efficient fuel consumption.  The best compliment I could give would be:  Six racks of baby backs - All gone!  18lb full packer brisket - All gone!  Compliments - Still flowing!  I'm not just blowing smoke up your Traeger!  

As for the son who helped with assembly, he will be moving into a new home this fall.  Guess what he wants for a housewarming gift.  His brother has a Timberline 1300 just waiting in the garage to welcome him to the Traegerhood!

text: I got this grill for Father's Day. I have BBQ'd a lot, never smoked anything. I went through all the set up and seasoning instructions. First grill it would not hold temperature at 225. Dropped to 195. Had to increase temp to 350 to get grill up to 225, then drop temp to get it keep it around 225, then it would drop again. This went on the whole time I was cooking. Second time I used the grill I smoked a pork shoulder. Started at 11 pm. I decided to start high at 250 and back down to 225 over the first hour hoping this would fix the aforementioned issue. Grill held temp at 250 perfectly, held temp at 245 perfectly, held temp at 240 perfectly, held temp at 235 perfectly, held temp at 230 perfectly, did not hold 225. As soon as I set it to 225 it dropped again to 195. This happened both with the super smoke feature on and with it off. However, the super smoke feature only works at 225 or below. I ran the grill all night at 230. Woke up at 6 am. Set the grill to 225 with super smoke on and it held perfectly for the rest of the cook. It's worked great since. I have only two more complaints. First, the app tells you the level of wood pellets you have left, i.e. 70%. However, the auger sits on the left side of the hopper, so as the wood feeds into the auger, it feeds from the left side and the level of the pellets drops on the left side of the hopper faster than the right side. I went to sleep at 100% level, woke up six hours later at 25% and about started crying. Why is it using so many pellets?! Go out to grill and level out the wood pellets by hand, app immediately registers 70% pellet level. If I had been away from the house, hypothetically, and saw the level at 25% after six hours, I would've returned to the house to add more when in reality it wasn't necessary. Not a big deal but something to know. I don't know if the sensor is using weight and the imbalance inside the hopper is causing this error or if the sensor goes off the level of the wood pellets inside the hopper. Second, maybe the app has this feature, maybe it doesn't, but I would love to be able to look at a graph of both the ambient temperature inside the grill and the meat thermometer over the life of the cook. See how fast meat is coming up to temp, where the stalls are, etc. Currently, it's either not available or I can't figure out how to get to that feature. I know other meat thermometers have this feature but it would be nice to have this all contained in one app. Other than those complaints, the grill has worked great. Excellent cook once it held 225 and the meat turned out fantastic. Five stars if pellet level indicator issue is fixed and app tells you temp progression through life of the cook.

title: Not what was promised
text:
I have been a Traeger fan for years, not my first Traeger, and I have loved all the fun cookout times that I have had.

I bought this grill during the original release, I got in line and felt fortunate enough to get one within a few weeks of the original shipping date.

I have worked in embedded systems development for years, and I got about what I expected when I saw a grill company trying to design an internet of things device, quite a steep learning curve on the part of Traeger, and a lot of patience from me.

I had a unit replaced because of an inexplicable blower fan error. I had a board replaced because the wifi antenna that they designed into it does not have sufficient positive lock and it came loose in shipping. I put up with all of the tunings and retunings of the PID control of the system, either causing the thing to spew smoke for the whole cook, or go out, or backup. I learned to dread the next firmware update, and what new quirks it was going to bring. 

A year or so in and I worked through all those issues with Traegers help, much happier now that so many of the firmware bugs were getting resolved, it has been more reliable, and I loved that I could program up my cooks and start them at night and wake up in the morning and expect it to be doing exactly the right thing at the right time. These were fantastic times, and I finally started feeling like I was getting what I paid for. 

Then the updates started to get worse. Unannounced database updates making it so my unit wouldn't show up without an app update, obfuscation of the only part of the app that I care about which is to control my grill, nonsensical "improvements" to the UI on the phone just making it harder to do what I needed to do.

Now with the latest app update I can't see my carefully curated custom cook cycles unless i use the manual interface on the front of the grill, and I don't believe that i can trust that to be there the next time I power it on and get an OTA update.

I'm one firmware update away from selling this thing and getting something else. 

I've been a die hard traeger fan since I first started but they are making it really hard to stay that way. I still appreciate the patience and responsiveness of their dealers and customer support, but man the app is terrible, and I feel like I am at the mercy of the firmware update schedule. For a top of the line product, this was anything other than a top of the line experience.

I’ve been a huge Traeger fan since I bought a pro 34 maybe 8 years ago. Where the old one fed pellets at a constant rate, the new one seems to rush pellets to the fire when needed, and slow down when not.  It gets to temperature faster and reacts to changes more quickly.  

I thought that the WiFire was a gimmick, but it surprisingly the coolest thing about the Ironwood.  I find myself watching the grill from my office as it smokes my briskets. The extra smoke mode is SO GOOD. 

It was easy to put together, is made of sturdy stuff, and I expect it will be as long-lived as my older one.  It’s not a cheaply made grill.  (My old one survived many winters, a snowmageddon or two where it was buried for several weeks, and terrible east coast humidity with no rusting, no real signs of aging.)

The food is fantastic. Skip gas grills. Skip coal. Traeger is the way to go.

A thing about Traegers.  When I got my first one, I was so enamored with it, the food was so differently delicious, that I made it my corporate gift of choice. When I had a team had a member who really had a good year, I got them a Traeger as a thank you.  It may be the greatest corporate gift ever, and everyone was psyched to get one. I’ve bought maybe 10 in the last few years.

Anyway, Traegering and the Ironwood is a really good choice.  It will last a long, long time, and the food is something special.  My daughters love bacon on the Traeger (it *is* weirdly fantastic), and my son and I love Traegered steaks and brisket. The recipes on the website are really great.

VERY happy with Traeger and my newest grill.

Operationally it has been a breeze however, there are a couple items that should be addressed.

At first, the level of smoke seemed non-existent, but after the updates it seemed to improve. I am still questioning how much smoke is truly being generated and wanting more, but the level of temperature control with convection is perfect - it stays within several degrees of desired internal temp.  Back to the smoke, and more specifically the Super Smoke setting; it doesn't seem to make any difference, and visibly, I don't see any more smoke coming out of the unit with it on or off. You can't tell me the meat soaks it all up and it just burns more efficiently (which is what I have been reading on the forums).  To easily address this, I would like to see an update come out with all egos set aside.

All-in-all, we are enjoying the Ironwood 885 nearly every day of the week and our food is coming out perfectly cooked (steady convection and temp control), but for the price and being a newer generation with all the fancy features I am hopeful for updates - which is why I took the leap and purchased the Ironwood 885 with WiFire.

title: Traeger catches fire, almost burns the house
text:
9/6/2020 @ 5:30pm 
I started the Traeger via the smoke mode. As normal, after the smoke engaged I turned the temp to 450 degrees and closed the lid (preparing to cook steaks). 
A few minutes later I went to check the temp and noticed it displayed a temp in the 500's which I have never seen before. 
I quickly opened the lid and flames were fully engulfing the unit and rapidly increasing. 
Flames were at approximately 7' high just under the patio cover so my wife called 911. 
I then grabbed a towel to hold the side handle and pulled the Traeger out from under the patio and began dousing it with water from the garden hose. 
Fire dept arrived and checked the patio cover structure for any problems and determined we were "very lucky the house did not catch fire.". 

9/7/2020  
Called Traeger (1-800-TRAEGER) and spoke to David. Recapped yesterday’s incident and he said to email a description and include supporting pictures. 

I sent the email and pictures to supportverification@traegergrills.com.

 9/8/2020 @8:45am
Called Traeger and spoke to Charlise. I asked if she had received my email and she said yes, looking at it now. She then said she would review with her supervisor and put me on hold for 18 minutes. Charlene then came back to the phone and said “since you are past the 3 year warranty there was nothing she could do for me.” I then asked to speak directly to the supervisor. She put me on hold for another 10 minutes. 
After 10 minutes Charlise came back and put her supervisor (Nathaniel) on the line and she dropped.  I asked Nathaniel if he has reviewed the pictures and supporting documentation and he confirmed he had. He said “those pictures are scary”. I said yes, my house cam very close to catching fire. 
Nathaniel then went on to say there is no coverage due to being past the 3 year warranty. I reiterated the fact that if my house had caught fire we would be having a different conversation. I am just looking for Traeger to back their product and help me get into a replacement Traeger. Nathaniel then said “sorry nothing I can do”. I then said this is a horrible display of customer service and I am very disappointed. Call ended.

I set the ribs on my gas grill to keep them steaming and opened the grill. The burn pot was over flowing with pellets and there were about three or four more full pots worth in the bottom. title: Best thing I've ever bought
text:
I've owned my Ironwood 650 for about 4 months now, it is without a doubt the best grill I've ever owned. We use it for just about any application where you would want to use a grill or standard kitchen oven. I especially love this thing for ribs, brisket, and beef jerky. For anyone considering this grill I've got a few recommendations:

-WiFi: The grill only supports a 2.4ghz connection, if your router doesn't support that you will be very disappointed. Also don't assume that your signal is strong enough to get to the grill, I did have to get an extender.

-Trager App: Sometimes it misbehaves, just force stop it and reopen and you'll be fine. Beyond that it's one of the best product apps I've ever seen in terms of content and features.

-Get the optional front shelf, it's sturdy enough to handle just about anything that will fit on the grilling surface and adds much appreciated real estate to work with.

-Buy your pellets at Home Depot, and buy 4 bags at a time. They discount bulk purchases by about 25%, I have been able to mix and match pellet types (Signature, Hickory, & Mesquite) and still receive the discount. For US Military Veterans and those that live in states with no sales tax, the deal is that much sweeter.

Enjoy!
