title: Continuously Smoking Machine!
text:
I've had the Ironwood XL for a couple months now, and I use it 2-3 time a week.  I purchased this solely with the mindset of having a pellet grill that produces more smoke than what I had (first gen Timberline and a Texas Elite).  It has met that requirement well.  In my opinion, smoked food off this grill tastes closer to what you'd expect from a traditional smoker, and it has the most smoky flavor that I've had to date off a pellet grill, even without the use of Super Smoke.  This thing constantly smokes, even at 275 degrees.  That might be what I love most about it.  Gone are the days of cooking at a super low heat for a few hours to maximize smoke.  

I thought everything was packaged well, and the video instructions available were top-notch.  I was never lost on what to put where.  A screwdriver and wrench were supplied.  Use of the wrench was, at time, difficult in a few spots, but otherwise, assembly was a breeze.  

The controller is cool, although, I would be perfectly happy with it not having a touch screen (I worry about longevity), but it all works well.  I really like that my pre-Traeger Meater probes connect to the controller.  That alone has me using those probes much more than I used to, because I don't have to have the Meater block nearby anymore.  I think the controller is very easy to figure out going through the options and whatnot.  Integration to the app is solid.  I think the app has come a long ways over the years.  

Cleanout is pretty slick.  I feel the days of busting out the shop vac are going to be much fewer and far between.  I'll occasionally take everything apart and just brush the ash into the Ash Keg.  The firepot/box never has anything other than pellets in it (no ash clumps).  Even under the firebox, there's very little that makes it in there.  I was worried about not being able to use foil on the drip tray, but it hasn't been an issue.  Just get yourself a plastic putty knife to scrape everything down into the Ash Keg.  It's super quick to do.  

I like all the large side shelf, although, I am hopeful I can one day get the induction burner to put in there.  I have the front shelf as well, so there is lots of space to work.  

One thing to note that I have experienced twice, but now I know to check.  When cooking at higher heat (350), I've shut the grill down, and I would notice smoke coming out of the cap over the grease drain.  Removing the ash keg I found there was some smoldering ash and grease in there (the first time this happened, the grill had been off for hours before I noticed when I went to cover the grill).  I thought I had let it get too full, but it has happened another time on an empty liner.  So I think you just need to be aware of this.  I check it every time after a cook to be safe.  The smoldering grease smoke makes the grill smell terrible.  Fortunately, by the next cook, it was back to smelling great again.  

All in all, this thing does everything I want, and I've been really happy with it!

title: Traeger Ironwood XL Indepth
text:
Best Traeger yet!!!

Background: My father recommended buying a Traeger in 2006 after he purchased one because he was tired of stoking fires in a firebox every 45 minutes for long cooking times. My father and I won several local BBQ competitions. If he recommended a product for this then it must have something going for it. So, I bought the Big Tex smoker and used it for years until a mouse got into the wiring and chewed through most of the wires under the auger. (Yes, the devil was caught and disposed of for the damage he created) after attempting to rewire the damage, the Temperature setting was never the same, so I purchased the Pro 34, 5 years ago. I used the Pro 34 for long cooks only, because the marketing of grill (A.K.A. reverse searing) was longer to complete than a Charcoal grill for steaks. After years of charcoal grilling, I decided to look into direct flame pellet grill for grilling which lead me to the Ironwood XL (It does not do). I just wanted to purchase one type of fuel instead of two (Charcoal and Pellets). I decided to get a different manufacturer for the direct flame pellet grill. (Please Traeger come up with a grill that has direct flame capabilities!) but also purchased the Ironwood XL for my long cooking times because of the changes from the Pro 34 and Ironwood XL are vastly different.

PROS: Lid Gasket for proper seal, Dual-Wall Insulation, Back Draft exhaust, Pellet Sensor, and D2 Controller. It was incredible how much smoke loss there was on the Pro 34 by simply putting a gasket on the lid. The Dual-Wall Insulation definitely helps with keeping the temperature within a 5 +/- degree difference making the smoke times more consistent. You will need to plan ahead until you get used to a more consistent temperature settings. REMEMBER, do not cook by time, always cook by temperature. The Back Draft exhaust system keeps the "warm" smoke in and the "colder" smoke out. This is how they achieve a more smoke flavor than before. Think about simple physics, Heat raises so anyone that has a smoker with a stack instead of back draft, you're losing a lot of good smoke flavor profile because the "good" smoke is simply rising up through and into the stack instead of circulating through the food. Hence the smokestack creosote. I'm not sure about the super smoke setting because you don't need to utilize this setting for long smokes. Like I said before, I use my Traeger for smoking not grilling. I never thought an app was necessary for a grill until I realized that I didn't need to go outside to check the level of pellets. Just use the app for monitoring, BTW I needed to leave for an appointment, and you can still use the app while not connected to the same Wi-Fi network. The pellets got low, so I had my wife add more pellets while I was out. 

CONS: EZ-Clean, Pellet Removal Location, Traeger Website Accessory Items, and Shutdown Procedure. Having the Drip Pan Collect Ash and Grease is great however, not having an Aluminum drip tray option makes no sense to not have for this Smoker. Traeger has made the maintenance easer by not needing to vacuum the ash (You still need to remove everything and use a brush to sweep all the ash into the drip pan) but the Trip tray will need to be cleaned after every cook because if you don't clean it, you'll take twice as long the next time to clean it. I have seen how the smoke comes through the drip tray and you can put an aluminum sheet down, just don't cover the slits around the edge of the pan. You also cannot (very easily) clean the funnel to the drip pan. Hence the need for aluminum. You are required to purchase at least one Traeger StayDry Pellet Bin & Lid to remove the pellets from the smoker. Maybe it would not be much of a Con if it was included with the smokers to utilize this function. Adding a $30 bin shouldn't make that much difference in cost for Traeger. This leads me to my last CON, this isn't really about the usability of the smoker but more about Traeger's Website for accessories. Great example, make sure you do not buy the Meater+, this will not connect to the Traeger's D2 Controller, you need to buy Treager X Meater if you want it to all work with one app instead of 2. Cannot find the Cutting board to go on top of the Pellet Lid, nor can I find the CookTop accessory. The D2 Controller on this smoker says you can pair a device like this but cannot seem to find it on the website. I can only assume it will be available at some point later down the road.

EXPERT ADVICE: If you are a previous pellet smoker user, read the manual. There are a lot of reviews stating that the smoker did not complete the seasoning phase at start up. This happened to me until I read the manual and found out one specific detail that really matters most. That is starting the Traeger with the Lid open as instructed on the older devices. DO NOT do this with this generation of devices. The main reason for this is because of the D2 controller. It has an open Lid sensor that feeds more pellets than normal because it needs to keep temperature and it knows that it will lose temperature because of the lid is opened. (GREAT feature by the way) If you attempt to start the smoker with the lid open it bypasses the startup procedure and feeds way more pellets than needed to start the grill. If the grill drops temperature more than 20 degrees, the lid was open to long and to many pellets where fed into the firebox. It time more time to reset the glow rod to reignite the fire. This also seemed to be an issue with looking at foods for longer periods of time. To be clear, I noticed this being an issue when the lid was open for 20 minutes. Use a probe or open the lid for less than 10 minutes. REMEMBER: "It ain't cooking if you're looking." Do not purchase a pre-built Item. The people at the store are just trying to get the job done and not putting it together like the consumer would. They don't cinch down the bolts and really do not care if there are extra parts after completion. Traeger does include the Tools needed as well so build it yourself.

If you cover your grill like I do, it makes it virtually impossible to take the cover off without 1) having to reach under the cover prior to removing the cover or 2) if you forget to do so, having that bucket fall off onto your deck and spill grease everywhere...every single time.  I guess you could replace the bucket liner after every use, but you can't cover the grill until you are sure that all of the grease is done dripping.  A more secure grease bucket would solve that problem.

title: PIECE of CRAP that will not smoke in the summer
text: DON'T BUY.  My grill will not go below 225-230 degrees regardless of the setting.  According to Traeger's troubleshooting guide it states if the ambient temperature is above 85 degrees the grill will not function below 225. In other words, you cannot smoke a brisket in the summer. After reading the MANY reviews this is a recognized problem with these grills. Move it to the shade it states.  Today and most any summer day in Texas it is around 90-100 degrees IN THE SHADE.   During the SUMMER is when you smoke briskets etc.  You cannot smoke a brisket at 225 degrees.  It was represented as a top of the line SMOKER by your dealer and the website.  I regret having purchased this grill as there was no disclaimer about not being able to smoke during the summer which is when you expect to use it.  Customer service wants to simply have you replace parts over and over.   I've replaced 2 previous controllers, two RCP's, cleaned the grill, fire pot, and lowered the smoke stack, and the meat probes read 30 degrees different from each other.  The very first day I used it the auger locked up and stripped the bolt that attaches to the motor.  I have had to do all the warranty work myself as no Traeger dealer will work on it, warranty or otherwise.  I am now realizing it is a DESIGN ISSUE as you sell this as a SMOKER....but it won't smoke during the summer when you need it.  If I had just wanted a GRILL I would have bought a grill which gets much hotter for grilling.  Last week they replaced the RCP.  This week I was assured it was the controller.  I found a new controller locally and bought it and it made no difference as I was hoping to smoke a brisket on the 4th of July.  It is a piece of junk IMHO.  THE PROBLEM is the DESIGN not faulty parts.  It simply will not stay below 225 degrees.  I wish I had my money back.  It will ruin a $60 brisket.  My oven cooks better than this.

I’ve continued to have problems and am unable to use the app on my phone as a result. Long story short, I regret buying this grill. I bought a Cadillac lemon. The only way I can use the grill by the control panel on the front of the grill. I’ve been in touch with tech support spending quite a long time with them on multiple occasions. They are stumped and of no help. So much for the hype! Needless to say, the only thing the app on my phone is good for, is looking up recipes to cook manually. Thank God for Hasty Bake and Weber charcoal grills. I recommend Hasty Bake and Weber over Traeger any day. Sorry Traeger, I’m not the least bit impressed. On a side note, even when cooking with this manually, the food turns out good. I use the grill even though the app is worthless.  One other thing, if I would have know Traeger is manufactured in China I would have instantly looked elsewhere. My bad, I thought Traeger was manufactured in the USA. Honestly, I made a mistake.

title: Waited too long to purchase
text: Can’t believe we waited so long to make the investment. Bought it 3 months ago and use it about 3 times a week. I can’t seem to screw anything up that I cook on it. Everything has come out better than restaurant quality.

title: Not Okay if Cooking Above 400
text: I clean my Traeger after every use. Shop vac it and put a new liner in it. Regardless of doing that my grill still becomes uncontrollably when it’s put over 400degrees. In fact the first time I tried I had a flash fire in the grill which damaged the back part of the smoker. As lang as it’s low and slow things are good but anything more than that is useless. As much as I paid for this you would expect it to work flawlessly.

title: Disappointed
text: I own 2 Traeger Timberline XL grills. I love the way they cook and smoke food with ease in operation and cleanup. The reason for not giving a 5 star review is that when the president and CEO announced to timber line XL he said it would be coming out with a Modfire pizza oven accessory. 2 years plus later no such item exists. Found out it never will. They should never advertise something they can’t follow up on or produce before announcing it to the public.

title: Disappointed in the quality
text:
I bought a 780pro about 4 months ago. Disappointed!!!
The door/lid is not a heavy enough metal to handle the heat. It will not close all the way. It is warped. The lid stop will not hold the lid from falling over the back of the grill. There should be a stop on both sides.

title: Mo Money
text: I was very concerned about spending the money on this smoker, when my electric smoker died. After using it several times now, I have found it to be amazing. The wood fired pellets with the hopper makes it so easy to smoke or grill with, without having to continuously be there to put more wood chips into the unit. The ease of use with the Traeger App is amazing. Money well spent!

title: Traeger 575 Wifi Review
text:
I am redoing my rating of Traeger and my 575. At first I was angry and upset that my grill was not working as I thought it should. Well it turns out the Traeger grills are a totally different animal than any of the others out there. I am referring to BBQ's like wood, charcoal, propane, pellets, I have had them all! They all have their places. Let's start with wood, I love wood the smell, the flavor of wood smoked meat. Dislikes direct flame; which is to hard to keep a constant heat and not burn anything. Wood is also the best for smoking. Charcoal- works well for BBQ, even heat, taste is ok. Not able to smoke with charcoal unless you learn how to.  Propane- YEAH! I don't see the reason for it. If you are going to use gas for cooking why not put it on the stove or oven. I'm not a fan.
Now let's move to pellets- I have never heard of or used one. I was intrigued, it is a grill that uses wood yet there is no open flame. OK! I'll try. 
WOW! Traeger's are a little pricey compared to others out there. Let's see what all the fuss is about and the price.
I purchased  the middle of the road Traeger 575. I thankfully purchased it from our local ACE Hardware. They have almost everything you could want for your grill. I went a little crazy and purchased the cover, cleaner brush, the orange cleaner, liners for the BBQ and the drip can. I also purchased the best pellets so far. I have only tried three different ones. The best so far is the Signature, it goes with everything. 
So what I learned is the Traeger 575 wifi is a great grill! I would love to have purchased the Flagship but honestly it is way more grill than I would have ever used. There are a lot of great recipes on the app. The timer and meat thermometer work excellent. The temp of the 575 if cooking small items, like a couple of burgers, a steak and two potatoes', the temp is off a little. Now if you are using it full the temp is dead on. 
Now the grill and the directions tell you to clean your grill after every two to three uses or depending on how greasy the meal is. MAKE SURE TO CLEAN your grill. A quick vacuum and wipedown is all it takes. Make sure to use the tray liners, makes cleaning easy.
Now for the cooking. I got mine back in July and I have cooked everything I can at this grill. I have to say it is AWESOME! I cooked "bacon" Yes! bacon right on the grill. The bacon stayed the same shape as I put it on the grill and came out perfectly crispy. In fact it was so perfect, my wife thought it was fake. 
Everything and I mean everything came out wonderful. 
The strange thing to me is when your grill heats up and tells you it is ready, you open the lid and expect to have this huge wave if heat hit you in the face. It never does. As well as when you place your food on the grill, you expect to get burnt by the flame. There isn't one!
If you have never cooked with one you need to find someone with a Traeger and become friends. LOL!
Maybe you can go down to your local retailer that sells them and ask them to have a Traeger demo day! Here you go Traeger have someone who is familiar with cooking on a Traeger and have demo days on a weekend. Cook and have food for people to sample.
P.S. for smoking I have done a few things that help with more smoke. I adjusted the top hat down a little bit and turned the temp down. I get more smoke this way.
I do not work for Traeger nor are they paying, giving or promising me anything. I just really like my grill. Now I want the Flagship just to see what it is capable of. I also love to BBQ, so I am a little biased. I would rather be cooking outside than inside.

title: Best Traeger Grill Yet!
text: This is my third Traeger grill I have purchased. Two smaller grills for camping and tailgating and now the Timberline XL. I was at the Los Angeles County Fair when I saw the XL and just fell in love with it. My sister and I demolished a perfectly good stainless steel built in propane grill in my bbq island to make room for this grill. It took us around 3 hours to demo including removing the stacked stone. Next came assembly of the XL and wow. We both agreed that this has to be the best quality product ever purchased. I have assembled just about everything you can imagine over the years (just about 60 yrs old). So easy to assemble and everything was well made and thought out. Took us around 1 1/2 hours to assemble.  Highly recommend the XL. Love Traeger products.

title: Great Smoker
text:
Great smoker, have it for 6 months and results are getting better each time. Treager recipes are good but  you need to tweak them to your taste.  Draining the pellets without losing some
To the ground is a challenge. Designing a bucket the hooks on to the grill directly under the shoot so you can direct the pellets from above.

title: Fantastic Product!
text: It does everything it’s supposed to and more! I’ve owned a Traeger since 2014.

title: Under Delivers On So Many Leveks
text:
I’m not sure it even deserves 2 stars.   From the start there’s nothing I’ve enjoyed about owning this grill.  The delivery was botched at best, without ringing my doorbell they left the 500lbs package, on a pallet in the street in front of my house, last I knew “curb side”was not in the middle of a residential street.  Neither the Bluetooth or wired thermometers worked.  After a lengthy text series with Traeger “customer service” they said I need to be in front of the grill to to do the last tests before they could send out replacements.  Those test were to wiggle the f@#%ing cables.  Received replacements that worked for the wired, zero correspondence from Traeger in the Bluetooth ones that need to be replaced, to be honest they are pretty low end.   

If you have time to deal with the nonsense and are a fan of low quality this is definitely the pellet grill for you

title: Lemon
text: My traeger smoker is about yr and half old and have replaced so many parts and still is not working right,have to prime it with pellets which means a tear down to put pellets in hot pot.Does not heat up quickly 45 mins or more to start ,will never buy another traeger product again.

title: Pro780 and Customer Support
text: Love my Traeger Pro 780, had it now for 2 years. Recently I had to contact Support as my D2 controller screen was not functioning, they mailed me out a new within 2 days, easy to install and I was back up and running a day later.  Customer Support was very easy to work with and helpful - Thanks.

title: Expensive for uneven temperature and no storage
text:
I would not recommend to a friend or buy again for myself, without considering other options. 
-- The left side (leftmost quarter predominantly) of the grill cooks 20-30 degrees hotter than the right. Clearly some oversight in the engineering. I have to plan my meals accordingly. 
-- The lack of an exterior surface or two to place utensils on a $1000 grill is beyond disappointing. Cannot overstate how frustrating it is to have no place to set a bowl, plate or grill utensil. Plan for another piece of furniture to make up for this.
--The inability to start the grill remotely is another bother, and fairly well hidden in their marketing of the WiFIRE capabilities. 
-- The cover is an additional ~$120 purchase
Consider other options, like Pit Boss for a better value.

title: Probe inserts are acurate
text: Using an cooking on this 34 pellet going on 3 years now love it

title: Worst grill and experience ever
text: I bought the Ironwood XL at Minnesota State Fair.  Was never told there was a 45 day return policy.  It hasn't worked properly from the day it was delivered.  I have had 8 phone calls with customer service and still don't have a grill that works.  Was told the flame sensor was not working, showed that on the screen and that it would have to be taken apart to check.  Now the service says that it is working and the pellet sensor isn't working.  I plan to report Traeger to the BBB.  I was mislead from the salesperson that sold the grill and the customer service received from Traeger is not what I would have expected.

title: I will have this one till I die.
text:
I bought my Timberline 1300 about 7 years ago and you coundn't ask for a better smoker.  I had a little issue with it learning how to operate it because u had been using an electric smoker and the board died.
I smoke whatever I want and it always turns out depending on the grade of meat.  My wife does not like brisket but when one gets smoked, she's the first one in line.
Keep it clean and replace the parts as needed and you will have smooth smoking.  I had the igniter go out and the thermocoupler, replaced them after 6 1/2 years and works like new.  Easy for me to replace but you have to pay attention.

title: LOVE IT LOVE IT LOVE IT
text: Done steaks, ribs, jerky (lots of jerky), chicken wings and on and on.  EVERYTHING without exaggeration comes out perfect.  Even in a 15mph wind it holds it temp and runs like a champ.  Highly recommend.

title: 3 day old grill no refund
text: This grill is garbage.  Mine had a flame sensor failure after 3 days and the company refused to refund.  this is in addition to a failure to complete the initial seasoning cycle.  Look on BBB and numerous BBQ forums and  you will see numerous people who struggle for weeks to get a properly functioning grill and Traeger refuses to refund.  Their refund policy is that there is no refund if it is used or even assembled.  So the only refund is if you send it un opened back to them.  So they do not stand behind their product.  They will ask you to play grill mechanic as they send you endless parts or your 2K piece of garbage.

title: Nope and nope
text:
I have the older Timberline which is great and when these came out I wanted to upgrade.

I’m retired military and live in Italy so it’s difficult to buy these things sometimes. I had the Base exchange special order it for me which took 3 months. I’m used to that and wasn’t in a rush so not a big deal. 

They ordered 2 so they could have another one in stock.  When the grill arrived, After unboxing, I noticed a huge problem.  I’m on 220v here. All the traegers are dual voltage so not a problem.  However, the induction burner is not!  Being used to that, I checked before plugging in so I didn’t cause the next issues.  But, wanting to get started, I figured I’d sort that out later.

 I  put it together which took about an hour. The grill didn’t even turn on! Reading online, it gives you a way to troubleshoot but I didn’t have an impact driver to open the panel.  I wasn’t about to mess with a new grill and deal with that headache.  I called the exchange and they swapped it out for the other one. Great!

I get the second grill , put that together and it turned on. I started the seasoning process and my power tripped.  I flipped the breaker and started over. I get an error code saying the heating rod is bad and needs to be replaced! That means there’s a short somewhere which was why the breaker tripped.

2/2 grills were defective!!!!!

Immediately got a refund. 

Now I don’t know what to do. I’m contemplating getting the ironwood but really hesitant because of this bad experience.

title: Excellent grill
text: Best grill I have ever had. Love it. Greatest tasting meat I have ever  cooked everyone loves the food prepared on it.

title: Arrived defective
text: We received our smoker quickly and put it together easily, only to find that the screen would not turn on. We spent hours troubleshooting with Traeger customer service, with the resolution being that they would send a new controller. We were told it would arrive within 5 days. We're now being told that it won't arrive for 9 days and likely won't be here in time for Thanksgiving, which is what we bought the smoker for. title: Amazing Grill/Smoker
text: I bought mine a week ago and have cooked ribs and burgers on it. Turned out absolutely amazing. Better than on my old smoker. The grill is easy to use and holds temp pretty well. I am cooking a pork butt on it for thanksgiving so I’m excited to see how it compares to my old Country Smokers smoker (from what I’ve experienced so far, its going to turn out even better).

title: AWESOME Grill
text: The Pro 780 being my first pellet grill purchase was the right move. People really talk a big hype about this grill and its definitely for a reason. This Traeger has really changed the way my family and I eat. The recipes are simple and the ability to control the temperature remotely is awesome. The flavors stand out from anything I have ever cooked on before. I have already sold my old charcoal and gas grill.  Super stoked about this product. Proud to be part of the TRAEGERHOOD.

title: Does not sear steaks
text: Don't be fooled by the marketing statements about searing.  This grill does not sear steaks adequately for steaks over 1.5 inches.  And if you buy be aware there is absolutely no returns no matter what especially if you buy from Ace Hardware.

title: SMOKING FINE...
text: Have had my 575 for over 3 years...still cooks amazing & is just the right size...love it...never any issues...

title: Huge letdown
text: I have been nothing but disappointed with this product. Especially since I have friends who love Tragger products however for the past year EVERY TIME I have used this grill is ALWAYS has a flair up and NEVER holds temp well it’s always getting way to hot by around 70-100f…. It’s basically unusable honestly. I don’t even enjoy using it it’s more of a headache than anything else. I have called the support line several times and done everything they has suggested and it has made zero difference! This is nothing against the employees what so ever they have been professional and extremely nice whenever I have had any concerns however the quality of this product just isn’t there and makes me want to sell it and get a different brand that will actually hold a temperature and not be a nightmare to use every time! When I first got the grill I was extremely excited and recommended it to friends however after using it I have had to take that back and honestly tell my friends this has made me almost never want to buy a Tragger again, it feels like you are paying for the name because I certainly have not paid for quality.

text: I've owned mine for about 2 years and couldn't be happier. I replaced my original small basic Traeger grille I'd had for maybe 10 years and it had ran it's course. The new Pro does everything I need a grille to do. I mostly do steaks, burgers, ribs just basic stuff but so far so good. Love the large pellet hopper and the easy clean out. I'm 78 and this will probably last as long as I'm allowed to grille. Thankyou Traeger.

title: Timberline XL Waste of money!
text: I have a small Traeger grill and decided to upgrade to what I thought was  their top of the line grill..  Cook times have been way off   A 12 hr cook time for a brisket takes 18 hours.  Last year the spatchcock turkey took 2 hr 40 minutes to reach 165*. This year 5 hr 40 minutes …. Worst turkey I have ever cooked!  I put an oven thermometer in and grill was 50* lower inside temp than set temp.  So, after a year of struggling with grill and 3 hours on the phone  Traeger said no fix.  They said it was working as expected.   So. Set grill to 275* and it is 50+ average lower than required.  Cook times have been 75% longer.  Doesn’t sound right to me.    They replaced temp probe, hotrod and thermal coupler.. no difference. They say it the algorithms the grill uses.   I say lies.  I used an oven thermometer. 3 wired probes to measure temps. All read 47-55 degrees colder than grill. They say it’s third party equipment issues.  Customer service is friendly but absolutely no help at all. Do not buy this grill unless you’re willing to figure out what the actual temps are when you’re cooking.

title: The best grill.
text: Bought this grill back in 2020, BEST grill Iv'e ever owned. NEVER going back to propane or charcoal. As long as the hopper is full, you have full control of temps and the cook cyle. Makes phenominal pork ribs. Heven't figured out how to cold smoke in it yet, need to figure out how to get temps down to 80F to cold smoke fish.

It is incredibly inconsistent with respects to the temperature. For example, when setting the thermostat on high, the temperature will fluctuate between 350-490. This happens randomly. So I have had multiple meals RUINED due to this inconsistent performance. Using the same pellets and following directions (quarterly cleanings - which is a PITA in itself). Sometimes it heats up and sometimes it doesn’t - it’s not a reliable product (especially for the price) and in fact the most unreliable grill I’ve ever used. I plan on switching to another product.

title: Great Smoker
text: This overall is a great smoker. I’ve owned this grill for a little over 6 years now and have used it a ton. For what it is, it is great. It holds the temperature real well and has held up through the years as expected. Using it is simple and pretty close to set it and forget it. I’ve replaced the controller, igniter and fan once. These typically will wear out and I think the burn pot will be the next to go. Granted I’ve stored this grill outdoors and rarely have stored it with the cover on. So I’m sure that has taken its toll on the grill. The grill puts out good smoke but not great. It’s not a stick burner so don’t expect stick burner quality food. If you want more smoke you’ll likely need to pay a lot more. I’m in the process of buying a more competition style pellet grill but the price is almost double. I’ve been happy overall and if this is your first starter smoker, you’ll be happy overall. It’s not the best but like what I said, it’s great for what it is.

title: Excellent smoker!

title: Please spend your money elsewhere.
text: I purchased this around Black Friday. Used it about 4 times and now have spent hours in the phone with Traeger trying to resolve the issue of it not working. No expedited shipping of replacement parts and seemingly no desire to make the situation right that doesn’t require me spending hours of my own time and tools troubleshooting and repairing. Cannot recommend this model or company based on current experience.

title: Great tasting meat!
text: Giving the Ironwood XL five stars but only had it a week.  The food coming off of it is so good.  Pork Butt, wings and chicken legs came out great.  Only issue was probes did not work correctly at first and the first person my wife talked to did not know the solution.  Probably a new worker.  The supervisor knew the required fix and now they work well after a reboot.  If you have an issue they seem to really want to find the solution and would have replaced the parts that didn't seem to work.   I may be slow at putting things together but it took a lot longer than 45 minutes to an hour to assemble.  You will need two people to stand it up as they recommend.  One week in I am pleased with it based on how easy it is to use and the great tasting food coming off of it.  It's not cheap but if it will last 10 years plus and keep making food like I am eating tonight it was money well spent.

title: Warranty Pathetic - Do it yourself Repairs
text: I have had this for 4 months.  Just went to smoke brisket for Christmas Eve, which is not wasted.  I set the temperature to 180 and then checked on it a few hours later and  the temperature was 225-235 and would not come down.  Chatted with customer service which were of no help.  I now found out the warranty covers them walking you through the faulty smoker and they ship you the part and then you get to replace it!  4 months and already issues. I was excited to purchase the Traeger and after dealing with my first issue with Traeger I could not be more disappointed.  I also have 1 of my 2 WiFi thermometers not working.  Can hardly wait for that call the them!

title: Excellent large cooking surfaces and even cooking!
text: Bought in Vegas at Cowboy Christmas. Was delivered before we arrived back home from the rodeo! We used Christmas smoking a large turkey and over 30 lbs of prime rib and everything turned out phanominal !!

title: Best Grill I’ve Owned!!
text: The Timberline has turned my wife and I into bar-b-cue pit masters!!  The ability to closely control temperature, the recipes available, and the flavor induced via super smoke are unmatched features for sure.  BTW, also the best pizza oven on the block!!

title: Cooks everything I have tried
text: I am able to cook large amounts of food, and also small amounts of food with great quality and smoke on the food

title: Magnificent beast of a smoker
text:
This is my first Traeger. After decades with standard BBQs I decided to take the plunge and ordered the Ironwood XL. I’ve fallen in love with this beast of a machine. Setup was pretty quick and easy but takes two strong guys to lift the main body (If you need to go up or down stairs or more than 20 yards you may need more help). The only setback was it took a couple tries to get it connected to my WiFi. After that we were off and cooking. 
The grill heats up quick and holds temperature well. The insulation is amazing. Even at high temp I can hold my hand on the lid. I like to grill year round so this is important to me. It was 40 degrees and pouring rain a couple days ago and I smoked a ribeye roast with no trouble.
In the first few weeks we’ve done baby backs, ribeye roast, salmon, pork loin, veggies, potatoes - you name it. And it’s all been great!

title: Serious problem that needs to be look into
text: When I purchased this grill at no time was I informed that they have a problem with flame out. It has happened 3 times with the last being the worst. The grill caught fire and I almost lost my house. I have called on this problem 3 times. All 3 times they had me go over the grill and it worked so they did nothing. title: Wifi junk
text: I'm in love with smoking food.  I like the the grill.  Lots of room.  The problem is the wifi. Hours later when I'm about to start a cook it won't connect.  I had to Uninstal the app and reinstall to get it to work.  That to me is junk.  I seriously hope this is remedied moving forward.  It's sooooooo disappointing.  I'm upset on how much I spent on this thing, to have the biggest reason I spend the extra money on this thing not work smoothly.

title: Mobility issues
text: I have had my Pro Series 34 for awhile and from a smoking standpoint there is nothing better but from an ergonomics standpoint with no front castors it is extremely difficult to relocate for cooking.  Poor design feature

title: Exceptional flavor
text: I have owned a couple of Traeger's and absolutely love them. I use the grill often. The options and recipes are endless. One of my favorites is the smoked turkey.

title: This review is for unboxing and setup review only
text:
Delivered 30 November 2023. Today is 06 January 2024. 

The unboxing and assembly instructions were very easy to follow and were spot-on.  Unfortunately, the chimney cap bolt was improperly machined (i.e., the bolt threads were not properly machined to match the threads of the pipe) which caused the chimney cap bolt to become cross-threaded as I was installing the bolt into the pipe.  The threads on the chimney pipe were undamaged.  I purchased an after-market chimney cap and chimney pipe, they were not sold separately, and I only used the nuts and bolts from the new cap to secure the original chimney cap to the original chimney pipe.  The after-market nuts and bolts were a perfect match for the original chimney cap and chimney pipe.

As of this review, 06 January 2024, I have not used the Traeger for grilling because I wanted to resolve the cross-threaded bolt issue.

title: Do not buy
text: Save your money… I owned a pro 22 for 7 years never had an issue. I have owned this unit for over a year and it’s been nothing but chat service calls. Yes I do get replacement parts but then I have to install them. It’s not that I can’t but on a 3800$ grill in which you have to buy a cover for. It’s just pathetic and yes I have asked for an exchange cause of all the issues and the answer is no. So please Traeger discontinue this unit till you get it right.

title: Rainbows and Unicorns
text:
Life is better, I’m happier, even my ex wife loves me, and unicorns and rainbows dance on my patio since I bought my Traeger 650, it’s that good.

The simplicity of operation is guilt inducing, given the excellent results.  Best chickens you’ll ever taste.  I like the solid build, semi insulated walls and lid seals (a must in the Midwest), and clear easy to use app.   I also found the 650 plenty big, as I’m not a party thrower.  

I would offer one suggestion.  The power cord plugs in vertically under the hopper assembly, and tends to fall out easily if bumped, pulled, or unit is moved, due to gravity.  Maybe some kind of clip, or side plug in.   Figured Traeger designed it that way for rain.

title: An unhappy customer
text: I've had my grill for 3 years now. It was great the first year. However, if I don't clean the hopper after every cook, even a small 30-45 cook, it won't heat up on the next cook. It also has always had wifi issues connecting to the app. You have to have some type of 2.5 internet or something and spectrum doesn't have that. They offered to call my internet provider but wow thats a lot of waiting and work. After spending $2k+ I am not a happy customer and may sell this and move to the Big Green Egg. I write this with disappointment.

title: I've owned 3 and like all of them
text: I own 2 of them and happy with them and looking  at the bigger one

title: Missing parts
text: Just started putting together and found out it’s missing washers. Super annoying. You spend $2000 on a grill, they should come with all the parts.

title: Good grill not so good design
text:
We purchased the Traeger Timberline XL in September/October 2022. We loved the concept that it can be built into an outdoor kitchen with cabinets for a cleaner look. The smoker/grill is amazing and food is delicious however, the design of the Timberline XL is not so great. 
The Timberline XL design is different than all the other models in a sense that it has built in storage under the grill. When we got our grill and set it up, everything was great until a week later we had a major rain storm in the Florida keys and everything that was in the inside storage underneath the grill got wet. I contacted Traeger because I noticed that the magnet door closure started to rust and wanted to know how the water is getting in. I was basically told that I should have bought a cover for the grill. For the price of almost $4,000.00 you could just add the cover which costs $150 or specify that it needs a cover not listed under essentials accessories. We have owned a Traeger before and never used a cover rain or shine in the FL keys. We ended up buying one for the Timberline XL because we had no choice.  At this juncture, my cast iron pans and cutting boards went to the garbage, the probe attachment will eventually fail from getting wet and Traeger blew it off like we should know it needs a cover. Water will get into the probe hole if it's raining and eventually cause issues with that. Because of the design of the grill a cover is needed and I wished that at this price Traeger would just include it with the grill or charge the $200 more and include it. Leaving it as a option to buy is pointless because as customer service told me "its needed."
Additionally, the bamboo shelves are also pointless because with the grill being covered and no air circulation they are in the garbage because they were covered with mold from all the humidity and Florida weather. With or without cover the bamboo shelves are a failed feature because they will get mold from being covered or rained on. 
In conclusion besides a cleaner and nicer build in look, the design of the Timberline XL is not good at all and unless you are looking for a clean outdoor kitchen look I would buy the older freestanding models. This grill is too expensive to have these issues.

text: I have owned several pellet grill brands. I have owned Yoder, Memphis, Recteq, Camp Chef and Pitts and Spitts. First of all the grease management system is the best I have seen as is the removeable fire pot for cleaning. I have never in all the bands I have owned had a pellet grill put out the amount of good smoke (thin blue smoke) this does even without the super smoke on. With the super smoke on it is out of this word with good smoke production. The controller is definitely the best in the business and the integrated app has options most don't have. The WIFI was very easy to set up and was working within 3 minutes. The lights that come on when the lid is opened are fantastic. Most brands have them in the interior of the grill and are worthless after 2 cooks. These lights are not to the lid on the exterior of the barrel and do not get covered in smoke. The grill when running is very quiet. I have had other brands where I am laying in bed and can hear the blower motor and auger running and were pretty loud. The pop and lock rail system is very awesome. I have bought the front shelf, Basket, drink holder and 2 roll holder/dispensers, One for paper towel and one for butcher paper. I have found the cooking surface to be very even with temp. I have cooked almost everything I always cook and everything has awesome bark and very good smoke flavor. I cooked a brisket overnight and it used about a half hopper of pellets. The lighted pellet hopper and pellet sensor tells the percentage of pellets left and has a low pellet alarm as well. Cleaning after cooking is a breeze, The porcelain grates are easy to clean with a hot cloth and wiped off. After a 12 hour cook very little ash. The fire grate comes out and you can vacuum out under it. I like the pellet auger drops the pellets down into the burn grate so you will never get back burn.

title: Beware. Not a long term product. Not worth the $
text:
My wife bought this grill for me 3 years ago for Father’s Day. I was very excited because I’d heard all the wonderful things about it. It was also a rather extravagant gift at nearly $1800 all in (prices have come down a bit).  First the good:  It is a superior product over most other grills.  It cooks evenly and the e wood pellets make anything you cook taste SO good!  The supersmole feature is an excellent touch as well but only if it’s a small project like a small ham or pork shoulder (for larger items such as Goose, Turkey, etc) I would still recommend a standalone smoker.  It’s Reasonably easy to operate and the app (when it works; more on that later) He is really terrific and helpful.

Now the bad news:  The app loses connection regularly And restoring it can often take quite a bit of time, which is pretty inconvenient when you’re trying to get something cooked. But that’s the least of the issues. The auger got jammed (Without us, realizing it, and without any alert on the app) Which backed up all of the pellets into the hopper box, which started a fire. We did not panic; we simply removed all the pellets shut down the grill And waited for everything to burn off which it did pretty quickly. We contacted customer service and we had to replace the control board and sensor which we did (about $500) and we took the motor off and cleared the auger manually as instructed. Ever since that time, the grill simply does not work. It takes forever to get started, and the auger still does not work properly. We reached out to support who suggested a few different companies in the area that could come out and service the grill. We chose one of those. ($100) After two weeks when they came out, they basically told us the grill was shot. They said, even if they could repair it, the cost would be more than that of a new Traeger. But, they wouldn’t repair it, because they couldn’t ensure that it would be safe after the fire.

So now, we have a (With all associated costs) a $2,000 platter box. We made one final call to customer service who said that there was really nothing they could do about it and that these things happen. And, I get it. Nothing lasts forever. As I said at the beginning, it’s a next level Product to begin with and when it works, it’s fantastic. But, it appears as though the shelflife of this is 3.5 years.  So, depending on your perspective and bank account, you lease the grill in effect, for $571 a year and then apparently throw it out?

Overall, we’re disappointed because we don’t have that kind of money. And, the amount of time we had to spend on this thing not to mention the money, which ultimately did not even yield into a useable Product was pretty frustrating. Customer service was very polite and kind, but, it’s clear that these things have a life expectancy. So, despite the fact, I do not prefer propane cooked grilled food, That’s what I’m back to.

This isn’t a post to tell you not to buy this unit, just to be aware of what you’re getting yourself into.

text:
So disappointed in this grill.  I've looked at in the store it for over a year and finally pulled the trigger and wish I hadn't.  Hardly got hot during the seasoning process, so cool that the oil didn't even dry or burn off.  Spent over 4 hours troubleshooting the inability to connect to wifi, going through every guide and video I could find for this controller (which are very difficult to find).  Waited on the phone for customer service for 55 min only to spend an hour walking through all of the stuff I had already done.  Customer service rep was nice but no help nor was the supervisor he was working with.   
Neither was able to tell me how to do a hard reset on the controller or how I can check/force a firmware update.  As a last resort I finally decided to pull apart my brand new grill to check the wifi antenna and, sure enough, it wasn't connected to the board.  
After repairing that I tried to fire it up to try a cook.  Set it for 350 and after 80 min it only reached 225 degrees so I gave up and put it to shutdown mode.   After cooking in my oven and eating, I restarted it and set it for 500 to see what would happen.  After an hour it just barely made it to 400, so I reset it at 400 to see if it would at least hold and.....nope.  Settled at 340 and came back up to 360 and hovered between there and 345.  Waited an hour on the phone again and gave up.  
After reading the reviews a bit closer on this thing I see this seems to be a common enough problem and they sure aren't making them like the last 2 Traegers I've owned. I'm not sticking around to shotgun troubleshoot and deal with this like others have.  It's going back to the store while the getting is good and I still can.
Sorry Traeger, you lost a lifelong customer.

title: Poor lid construction
text: I purchased my Pro 780 at the Houston Rodeo several years ago. I can say I enjoy it but it is a shame to me that it does not completely meet this statement found on their website:  "WILL THIS GRILL FALL APART WITHIN A YEAR? Traeger grills are built-to-last. Every Traeger features superior structural construction, an ultra-sturdy base, and built-tough steel legs. If something does go wrong, our ironclad 3-year warranty and 365 days of customer service will cover any issue that may arise." Honestly the only place it has superior struction is in the base of the pit but not where the pit is used the most which is the lid. Less than a year the the opening and closing of the lid weakened the lid hinges and screws. The hinges began to bend then tear due to not being able to handle the weight of the lid when opened. There is nothing off load the lid's wiehgt off the hinges. I looked at other pellet grills such as the Ptit Boss and saw how they structured their support for the lid when open. I wish Treagar had the same. Due to the hinges bending the door does not close correctly. I did call customer service. I had to go through a process I am sure they have done quite often with may other customers and of course it did not resolve the issue. They sent another lid, hinges and handle but in no time the same thing is happening. The hinges are bending due to the weight of the lid and lid not closing correctly. I guess I will have to call agian to get it all replaced. These pits are not cheap but it sould not be advertised as "superior structural construction" because the lid system is not superior at all.

title: It’s fine, but over priced.
text:
I’ll start by saying that there are some pros and cons to this smoker. Pros: Lot’s of cooking space, probably more than I needed for my family of three. Heavy duty grill grates, even the top racks are stainless steel and feel solid. You won’t see these in the less expensive models. It seems to cook evenly across the surface. Pellet bin is probably the easiest to clean out along with the drip bucket. It has a nice drip tray that cleans easily and I think the heat shield works as it should. The touchscreen for the controller is great, it’s easy to use and I love the induction burner. Also, the grill grates on the bottom are in three pieces and will fit in my dishwasher. The grill looks nice and the casters roll well. Assembly will take a few hours. It’s extremely heavy and you’ll need someone helping you put it together.
The cons. It’s expensive. The app won’t stay connected to the smoker as it should. After many phone calls to Traeger, they ultimately decided it’s my problem because my WiFi is overused. Who knew 1gig fiber optic is not compatible with their controller and app. The controller only works on 2G, so my router is separated between 2and 5G with the bulk of date is being used on the 5G. I’m now experiencing one of the wireless meat thermometer trying to connect to the controller while it’s in its charging base. I don’t know what’s going on with that, but I refuse to call in just to be connected to someone overseas. That’s right, Traeger outsources its call center. Traeger claims that all the ash from the burn pot is supposed to blow into the drip bucket, it does not. In fact, there is very little ash in there. I had to buy a small shop vac just to get it all out. The inside of the smoker has where the pot is and the drip bucket are separated by a large hill like piece of metal.
Overall, it cooks as it should. I wish the app would work like it’s supposed to and the ashes would make it into the drip bucket. I should have reviewed more high end smokers before purchasing to see what I was missing out on, but where I live, we only have big box stores. I think if you spend half of what this Timberline XL cost, you’ll be missing heavier grates, induction burner, 2 wireless thermometers and maybe a little square footage of cooking space.

title: Not what I expected for the price
text:
It started with the shipping process. About 4 days after I ordered my Traeger Timberline XL, it was still showing “order being processed” on their website. On the 5th day it showed shipped. I called to get an estimate of when it would arrive as I was preparing for a large party and was hoping to have it by then. 40 minutes later I finally got a live person on the phone. 
Even though the “agent” was very polite and kind, she could not tell me when it would arrive. I then asked her where it shipping from and she could not answer that. I asked her if there was a tracking number, and she said not at this time. I asked her if she knew where it was, and she said no and all she could tell is that it left the warehouse. I said, what warehouse and she said she didn’t know. So now I said, Traeger has shipped one of its grills, and has no idea where it went or where it left from?  She said, that is correct but it has been shipped and you should get it soon. She said she would follow up with a tracking number in an email the next day. I said ok and since I was getting anywhere I thanked her and hung up. In all, this took about 30 minutes on the phone with her because she kept putting me on hold to research my questions. 
The next day I texted the same question via there “online live support.”  I asked the support person to call me asap. When I finally got the call I started asking the same questions as the day before. This time they had a tracking number from AAA Cooper Transportation but once again had no idea where the grill was. I asked to speak to a manager and a very arrogant guy came on the line. I asked him, where is my grill and he said he wasn’t sure but he “thought” is was probably shipped from Auburn Wa warehouse which is about 20 minutes from my home. He couldn’t give any verification of where it was shipped from or where it was and his attitude was clearly an attitude of “and I don’t really care.”  I was done. I decided to call AAA Cooper Transportation myself who is located in Alabama. A lady came on the line and I gave her the tracking number. She said she thinks it might be at a warehouse in SeaTac Wa and she gave me their number. I called them and they said it was given to another shipping company and is probably in Tacoma Wa and she gave me their number. I called them and immediately the lady recognized my name and said “Oh, we have your shipment.”  I said great, when will
It be delivered?  She said, next week. I asked, can I pick it up? She said, come on down, we’ll help you load it. So 7 days after I ordered it, which had started out in a warehouse 20 minutes from my home, I had to drive an hour to pick it up so I could have it in time for my party. 
You will likely read that Traeger customer support is for the most part worthless and time consuming. I  here to attest in full that that is very true. 
My grill, once I put it together, does not hold a consistent temp. 2 days ago I spent and hour and a half on an “online chat support” asking why my Traeger which I had set to 250 degrees, would get to that temp and then go back down to 203 before starting to come back up to 250 and then passing 250 for 282. The answer was, a fluctuation of 25 degrees is normal. I said, “you can’t do math very well as my is fluctuating -47 degrees and some times +32.”  
I’ve given up on Traeger. Poor customer service, poor support, and an overly priced product that doesn’t do what they say it will do. I’m not even going to go into the fact that my upper grills do not fit correctly and won’t stay in place. I think the grill is bowed outward at the top. 
It’s unfortunate that I’m going to recommend you go with another brand. For the last 5 years I’ve used another brand and never had any issues. I finally wore out the smoker I had been using so I thought I would upgrade to the Mac daddy Timberline XL and instead it turned out to be an expensive downgrade.

If you use a cover, the pail  falls when you remove the cover. I needed to design a latch that retains the pail. It could been designed a lot better without adding cost.  Hopper clean out is difficult as the door is behind the grill and the pellets do not free flow out of the hopper. A stick needs to be poked through the anger protection screen.  I'm sure that many people have just removed the screen.  The controller is easy to operate and the Mobil app screen is laid out well.  Cleaning the ash put requires all the heat shields and grates to be removed. Chamber cannot be removed and dumped, it has to be vacuumed.  Other competing grill have buckets that can be removed.  All in all, heat stability is good, controller is good but the pellet unloading process and ash pit cleaning ergonomics could be a lot better.  It a middle of the rode product at best.

title: Caster Wheels Fall Off
text:
bought the grill about a month ago. I assembled the grill and started rolling it into my garage. The surface of my driveway cement has a slight rough spot where the surface of the driveway has chipped away. When I wheeled it across that spot, the two caster wheels fell off. The wheels come attached to the legs so I know it wasn’t an assembly error. I contacted Traeger and the support agent was friendly and was very helpful…kind of. 

She was happy to send me a new set of wheels. I told the person that I was pretty sure the problem was with the way the wheels connected to the legs and as the wheels came attached to the legs, I think I need new legs not just the wheels. The agent was positive that the new wheels would solve the problem and sent me the new wheels. I recite new wheels and attached them to the legs. I moved the wheels carefully back and forth mimicking what had happened previously. I could easily pull the wheels off. 

So I called Traeger again. New agent, but just as friendly as the first. This agent had me take a short video showing how the wheels would easily come out of the legs. He agreed the problem was with the legs and offered to send me two new legs and some free rub for the inconvenience. New legs arrived today (no free rub…so much for my inconvenience) and I moved the wheel slightly back and forth as I had done previously, and the caster wheel came off. At this point I’m inclined to think there might be a design problem. The smoker legs showed up today. 

However, one has the same problem as the others. It is a design flaw. There’s a small ring around the peg of the caster wheel that slips into a very small grove in the leg’s sleeve. If the wheel is moved back and forth enough, the wheel easily slips out of the grove and falls off. 

The problem will occur if the wheels are on rough ground and catch on something while you’re pushing it. The force of trying to push the grill over the catch is enough to cause that small ring to slip out of the groove resulting in the wheel coming off. I’m still excited to use the smoker. I just need to remember that pushing the smoker over any rough spot in the cement may cause the wheels to fall off. This is my fourth smoker. My last smoker was the Ironwood 885. Never a problem. It wheeled over the same rough spot without difficulty. Part of me thinks that maybe I was better off sticking with that smoker.

I Love This Thing

title: Don't ever buy a Traeger Ironwood XL

Than they want me to fix it also. I'm disable and can't physically do that. So now I'm stuck with a $2000 grill that hasn't worked properly since day one and Traeger is unwilling to replace it or repair it. DON'T ever buy a Traeger.

title: Consistent

title: Super features for my first smoker
text: Bought in May and very pleased with it’s versatility

title: Garbage Product
text: This is a garbage product.  After 3 weeks ownership, I have replaced every electrical component with new parts Traeger has sent me.  I have had to rebuild/reassemble the mechanical components 4 times.  All at the incompetent direction of Traeger's surly offshored support staff. title: Very satisfied!
text: The smoker works so well.  The app really makes it easy to control the smoker when you’re not close by.  Nice even smoke on ribs with a well defined smoke line.  So much better than an electric smoker I use to have.

title: No smoke!
text: I bought this three months ago (my 2nd Traeger), and I am extremely unhappy. My food has no smoke flavor. The last Traeger rep told me it's meeting temperature and holding it's fine. I kept saying no smoke flavor, it's fine it's hitting temperature. I'm now stuck with a smoker that doesn't smoke. Let me send you some more quick fixes. I went to the library and tried all your quick fixes before I called. I was done with that.

title: Killer Griller!!!!
text: Wanted a Traeger for a long time, and finally made the purchase.  Wanted the Ironwood, but ceramic coated grills is a complete show stopper for me.  So I bit the bullet, spent the extra money and went for the Timberline.    So far no regrets.  Ribs, brisket, wings, chops, and burgers so far have all been a smash hit with everyone!!!   I’ll likely never use the side hot plate and it cost a little more than I wanted to spend, simply because I will only buy bbqs, and grills with stainless grills or I wont buy it at all, but in the end, the product it produces is really astounding and I am flat out very impressed!!!   This pellet grill is really great and I would buy another one day when this one wears out.

title: Misleading capabilities on website
text: This smoker does not link to any MEATER thermometers.. you will have to operate two apps in order to use them. The wifire means nothing for the thermometers. You have to have a touch screen Traeger model in order to use them… $400 dollars I would not of spent otherwise on a MEATER block

title: Ironwood XL casters
text: Great grill heavy and issues with the wheels falling off every time I try and move it. It’s stationary now so it’s not a problem but the casters don’t stay in place

title: Best Grill EVER!
text: An amazingly well thought out and designed grill!  Our first cook came out FABULOUS!

title: Unbelievable!!
text: Shipping was on time and grill showed up undamaged. Assembly was a breeze and didn’t take much longer then 30 min. The ironwood xl is a well put together machine! Looks fantastic and cooks amazingly even. I am a past pit boss owner do to affordability. If you can afford a Traeger I highly suggest you do so! It’s been 3 weeks and I have made dinner on mine every night but 3 and we were away and I couldn’t wait to get home and cook dinner the next day. The pid is fantastic and very user friendly. Also looks amazing! I also purchased the front folding shelf and the pop lock storage bin. Both are perfect and also suggest! The ash pan/grease trap funnel system works perfectly no more shop vac or removing all the racks and drip pans just take the catcher and dump. Changing pellets and or just emptying the hopper is a breeze and with the stay dry pellet bin it’s even more convenient! All in all I rate this grill very high and highly recommend!

title: RUST
text: I've been generally pleased with this grill, but the warranty is a joke.  The grill has rusted along the opening and they won't replace the part because it hasn't rusted through.  Just live with it until it rusts through and they will replace it.  I can't stress enough how stupid this is.  Tommy Boy was right when he said that about guarantees.

title: horrible
text: I purchased this and I am not happy. This poor smoker has wild temperature swings of 100 plus degrees despite being cleaned every use. I wish i had purchased another brand of pellet smoker as this traeger was a complete waste of money. I never leave my pellets in the smoker when not in use, they get stored in an air tight container indoors. The traeger trouble shooting guide through the app was zero help. Do not buy traeger.

title: Best grill/smoker I’ve ever owned
text: Super stoked on my 780. I don’t know why anyone would give it a one star review for petty things like shipping damage or not seeing the smoke. Best grill I’ve ever had that produces the best steaks I’ve ever had. I’ve been to fancy restaurants and paid $200 for steaks that weren’t this good. Also, while I’m not a big fan of chicken, this grill makes chicken actually enjoyable. I would recommend a Traeger to anyone and everyone. Thanks guys! Please send me free stuff.

title: Igniter Not Detected
text: After a month got Igniter Not Detected.  Traeger is sending replacement parts but I no longer trust that this smoker won't just shutdown mid smoke.  Now every time I put an expensive meat on the smoker Ill be nervous that it will just stop mid smoke.  Need more reliable option

title: Pro575 Aug 24 - Bought Direct from TRAEGER
text: Unit was damaged in shipping. Had to bend the drum back into shape with pry bars. Now the lid has big gaps between it and the drum causing leaks. Unit does not provide much smoke flavor. We bought pellet tubes within the first two weeks of owning to add more smoke flavor. Shipping took a long time. 9 days from Georgia to Pennsylvania

title: Great Grill/Smoker
text: Great grill/smoker. If you’re tired of feeding wood into your smoker all day then get one of these.

title: Don't expect a smoke flavor
text: As far as a grill goes it's a great product. I have wanted a traeger forever because I love smoking. I preached Traegers to everyone. But if you love anything with a smoke flavor don't waste your money. I have cooked on super smoke for hours and still doesn't have a smoke flavor at all. My first master built that uses chips was so much better. I no longer recommend to anyone if you love true bbq smoke flavoring. I have had it 2 years and it has never given that smoke flavor. Don't waste your money.

title: OG Timberline 1300
text: I bought one of the very first Traeger timberlines 1300s. It has been the best smoker I have ever owned. Still going strong, dependable and reliable, each and every time. Sad I would like to upgrade to the new model, but mine is still performing optimally. I know things have changed since I purchased mine, but the guys at Texas Star Grill shop in Houston is an incredible place for all your smoking needs.

title: Excellent Ironwood
text: Just recently received my ironwood 650. First time ever smoked a rack of beef ribs and they turned out perfect! Today will smoke a meatloaf. Very pleased with the ironwood!

title: Ironwood 885
text: This grill is worth every penny! It grills excellent and smoke flavor is great. Would recommend it to anyone.

title: State Fair special Ironwood XL in Iowa
text: Just received the Ironwood XL today.  Seasoned and ready to go.  Assembly was a bit long but that may be the person  Bit disappointed in the rotating wheels that both fell out when i lifted grill to move. Would appear they were not properly seated during manufacturing process.

title: Better than anticipated
text: I have a habit of being intrigued with things, using them a few times and then forgetting about them, not this.  This has just about completely replaced my propane grill and I've used it more days than I haven't in the time I've had it, it's a hit amongst the family.

title: Good Grill, Bad Technology
text:
Bought this grill a week ago. Plugged it in and immediately had display issues with the controller and had to go through an hour of time with the support team in order to get them to send a replacement. Once that was sorted out, went to connect the grill with wifi and the app crashes when adding the grill. Have spent countless hours talking to support to try to get this fixed with no end in site. 
The grill itself is very good, but the technology on the grill has issues and there are several issues with the wifi/app connection which leave us without this feature, which is the whole reason we bought the grill. Overall disappointed after spending $3k+ on this product.

title: Overall, liking it.
text:
Great grill. Happy with the results. However, now I know why it was on sale. The hopper door is on the wrong corner. Can’t get a bucket under it because the cross plate between the legs is in the way. Also, can’t tighten the door shut because the internal threads are apparently stripped. No I did not overtighten it. It was loose from the get-go. Anyway, I’m pleased overall and do recommend it.
Also, the recipes I’ve tried have had good results.

title: Great Siler, easy to use and perfect every time
text:
We bought the timberline XL about a month ago and have been very happy with the results we are getting.  It is especially nice when you just don’t have time to sit and take care of the stick burner smoker that we also use.  

We also like the availability of information available from the other users.

title: Big Traeger Guy, but not impressed.
text: My unit came damaged even though the box was perfect. Traeger sent me out the new part. After 2 uses, the unit stopped working. Spent hours with the support line for them to tell me it was a bad wire  harness. Doubt it’s a wire harness when this thing has 4 mother boards on it.

title: COOKS GREAT ... "WIFIRE TECH" IS BROKEN
text: They push the "WiFire Technology".  After trying time and time again to connect to my device using the phone app, I researched the issue to find that they did NOT put a WiFi antenna on the unit.  So you're trying to connect to the router directly from the printed circuit board.  My WiFi router is 20' or less from the device and it sill won't connect.  The "WiFire Technology" is useless unless maybe you place your WiFi router on top of the Traeger grill!  A joke.

title: Traeger Quality
text:
Great grill/smoker
Love the mobile/wifi integration
Very happy with my purchase!

title: Best Grill ever! I'm truly spoiled now.
text: This is my 6th grill (3rd pellet grill) but first Traeger and well worth the purchase. The grill only takes about 20 minutes to get to a stable temperature, unlike my previous grill which needed an hour to "settle" down to a steady temp. It is well insulated and was not affected by wind. I love that there is no pellet dust or ash on my food now, its pretty much contained in the lower part of the grill where it should be. The controls are very easy to use and I can adjust the temperature from my phone....WHAT?! I also like the built-in thermometer connectors (I don't use nor trust the wireless MEATER due to a previous bad experience with that product). The grill easy to disassemble for cleaning. I kinda wish I purchased this a few years ago but on the flip side, I can appreciate how good I have it now. :)

title: Pro Series 575
text: I live on the Gulf and the salt ate my last Pro22. This wifi is Really Idiot proof. No more staying up all night drinking a 12 pack to monitor the temp and add wood to my stick smoker. Although that is the fun of a stick smoker. I love my Traeger though.

title: Needs a lot more design work!
text:
-Assembly is frustrating because there are no words. Pictures only. So you need to make a lot of assumptions. There is a link to see a video but there are no words there either.

(wheels come assembled) In order to keep the grill from tipping over, I had to hold the shelf up which then bent as well. title: Smoking and grilling perfection

title: Poor Quality
text: During the second use the grill shut off after an hour, and would not turn back on. Had to throw out the meat I was smoking. Grill would not turn back on. A fuse was blown. Replaced the fuse, tried to turn on and it immediately blew the fuse again. Now I have to go through an entire series of test to determine what blew the fuse and then replace it. When I buy a product, especially something with a price tag such as this, I expect it to work more than twice before I am on the phone with customer service, replacing parts, and spending MY TIME trying to figure things out. I thought about getting a TRAEGER for over a year and finally got one. 100% buyers remorse now. Product needs to be made better to last more than two uses. The other option is to reduce the price to match the actual quality of the product. If your looking at TRAEGER vs a less expensive brand, I would go with the latter of the two options as you will more likely be paying for the quality of the product you are purchasing opposed to way over paying for poor quality.

title: New Ironwood 885

title: 1st pellet smoker

title: Traeger ironwood 650

title: Gives me PTSD every time I use it.
text: This grill has given me PTSD every time I try to smoke now. From day one this thing blew up on me several times. Now whenever I start this thing up I'm not sure if it's going to work or blow up. When it happened I got on with customer support (who gave me useless, scripted answers) and basically ended up giving up on any resolution. I don't want to spend my day trying to fix this defective product. I make sure to clean the grill and vacuum the ash out before every use. It has become a chore to even use this junk. I use Traeger pellets but that doesn't affect the problem. I even have a special container I keep the pellets in with a basket to shake the dust off. If it's out there, I've done it. I ended up finding out that the temp probe on the unit is between 30 to 40 degrees off. It's reading 30 to 40 degrees hotter than it actually is. Yes the probe in the grill is clean. Bottom line is this machine is junk and has turned me away from any more Traeger products.

title: Had to return.

title: Does not live up to expectations

title: We love our TimberlineXL

Highly Recommend.

title: Traeger Ironwood 650

text: The smoker often struggles to warm up to the set temperature, even at lower temps such as 250. It is inconsistent, sometimes heating up well and other times not. title: Perfect entry-level smoker

title: Don’t Do - it Buyer Beware
text: Received this as a Christmas gift a few years ago.  Initially it was fine but after a few uses it went down hill in that it does not reach the set temperature.  Company advised based on their review of the smoker remotely the temperature setting was within their 20 or 25 degree tolerance and declined to send me a new temp gauge. I’ve continued to over compensate with this by setting the temp 25-50 degrees over where it is needed for recipes and done okay getting the desired results. title: Smokin’

text: Grill leaks out the back just after a couple cooks. I’ve followed customer service instructions and they keep saying to do more things and that it’s our fault for not keeping it clean. title: Slow cooker… really slow cooker.
text:

title: Smoke on.
text: Easy assembly.  Holds temp to a +/- 8 degs. It has the best smoke infusion of any smoker I've ever owned.  Bluetooth connection to my phone to let me track its performance is a real bonus.  I recommend the cover and side table accessories.

title: Avoid Traeger at all Costs
text: I purchased the Timberline 850 as an upgrade from my old Texas elite, and it was a big mistake.  The Texas elite was great, never had an issue, and was like a tank in terms of durability.  The Timberline 850 is the opposite in nearly every way.  First were the connectivity issues, then the large swings in temperature. title: Lightly used Ironwood and the power supply is shot
text: I upgraded to an Ironwood Series about 2 years back.  I have used it 12-15 times to this point.  I keep it clean, it is covered on a patio, and has a Traeger cover I bought to protect it.  I have had issues with it maintaining temperature since I have had it, but being an experienced (I own a Weber Smokey Mountain/Kamado Joe/Cook Shack) smoker, I understand it isn't ceramic/insulated and just adjust the temp higher as necessary to maintain internal temps.  No biggie, I can work around that even with the 1500 price tag.  But what I can't, is the internal electronics.  I tried to fire it up recently (after not using it for a couple months) and I get no power.  Tested the outlet and it works fine.  No water, it is completely dry internally being under cover.  No insects or other issues that would interfere.  I read through the "Support" and have tired chat and calling.  I was left on hold a couple times for longer than I could wait, and the chat rep never responded in the chat.  I am hoping this review will get me some response.  At this point, I can't be an advocate for the Ironwood Grill.  I hope support can change my mind.  If anyone reads this, please contact me.

title: If you enjoy headaches, this thing is for you!
text:
I’ve been using my Timberline 1300 for a few years now. It’s a decent smoker and does its job well when it works. If you’re thinking about grilling on this thing though, go somewhere else. If you live in a colder climate and want to grill year round, this grill is not for you. 

This grill is also not for you if you’re on a time crunch. The grill takes absolutely forever to get up to temp (if it actually even makes it to the temp you set it to). Then, good luck holding that temp once you put in your meat. They’ll blame it on poor quality pellets, even when you’re using a fresh bag of their own. 

If you’re lucky enough to get to a high temp, then you get to see how easy it is to start a grease fire in the thing. The fire usually likes to then work its way down the auger, burning up all the pellets along the way, so be ready to empty your hopper so they all don’t go up in flames. 

With the high temps then comes peeling paint and inevitable rust! Fun! Even if you keep it covered religiously when it’s not in use, you won’t escape this either. 

I hope Traeger is embarrassed charging as much as it does for this grill, because I’m sure embarrassed that I purchased one.
